````typescript
  id: z.string().uuid().optional(),
  topic: z.string().max(200),
  system: z.string().max(50).nullable().optional(),
  focus: z.string().max(100),
  difficulty: z.string().max(50).optional().default('medium'),
  isCorrect: z.boolean(),
  timestamp: z.number(),
  questionWordCount: z.number().int().nullable().optional(),
  errorTag: z.string().max(100).nullable().optional(),
  subcategoryName: z.string().max(200).nullable().optional(),
  conditionName: z.string().max(200).nullable().optional(),
});

const SyncSRSItemSchema = z.object({
  questionId: z.string().max(100),
  interval: z.number(),
  repetition: z.number().int(),
  easiness: z.number(),
  dueDate: z.string(),
  lastReviewed: z.string(),
  quality: z.number().int().min(0).max(5),
  difficulty: z.union([z.string(), z.number()]).optional().transform(val => 
    val !== undefined ? String(val) : undefined
  ),
  stabilityScore: z.number().optional(),
  updatedAt: z.string().optional(),
});

const SyncSavedQuestionSchema = z.object({
  questionId: z.string().max(100).optional(),
  questionText: z.string().max(5000).optional(),
  correctAnswer: z.string().max(500).optional(),
  explanation: z.string().max(10000).optional(),
  topic: z.string().max(200).optional(),
  system: z.string().max(50).nullable().optional(),
  type: z.enum(['saved', 'flagged', 'missed']),
  userNote: z.string().max(2000).nullable().optional(),
  repetitionLevel: z.number().int().optional(),
  nextReviewDate: z.string().optional(),
  updatedAt: z.string().optional(),
  // Allow additional fields from client
  id: z.string().optional(),
  question: z.string().optional(),
  options: z.array(z.string()).optional(),
  correctAnswerIndex: z.number().optional(),
  rationale: z.string().optional(),
  condition: z.string().optional(),
  conditionId: z.string().nullable().optional(),
});

const PostSyncSchema = z.object({
  userId: z.string().min(1).max(100),
  performanceRecords: z.array(SyncPerformanceRecordSchema).max(1000).optional(),
  srsItems: z.array(SyncSRSItemSchema).max(1000).optional(),
  savedQuestions: z.array(SyncSavedQuestionSchema).max(500).optional(),
});

// ============================================================================
// HELPERS
// ============================================================================

// Batch size - MUST stay under Cloudflare's 50 subrequest limit
// Each batch makes ~3-5 queries (createMany, findMany for conflicts, etc.)
// So we process fewer items but use bulk operations
const BATCH_SIZE = 25;

// Retry configuration for transient Accelerate failures
const MAX_RETRIES = 3;
const INITIAL_RETRY_DELAY_MS = 500;

/**
 * Check if an error is a transient Accelerate connection error that can be retried
 */
function isTransientAccelerateError(error: unknown): boolean {
  const message = error instanceof Error ? error.message.toLowerCase() : String(error).toLowerCase();
  return (
    message.includes('unable to connect to the accelerate api') ||
    message.includes('network') ||
    message.includes('dns') ||
    message.includes('timeout') ||
    message.includes('econnreset') ||
    message.includes('econnrefused') ||
    message.includes('socket hang up')
  );
}

/**
 * Execute a database operation with retry logic for transient failures
 */
async function withRetry<T>(
  operation: () => Promise<T>,
  operationName: string,
  log: ReturnType<typeof createEndpointLogger>
): Promise<T> {
  let lastError: unknown;
  
  for (let attempt = 1; attempt <= MAX_RETRIES; attempt++) {
    try {
      return await operation();
    } catch (error) {
      lastError = error;
      
      if (!isTransientAccelerateError(error) || attempt === MAX_RETRIES) {
        throw error;
      }
      
      const delay = INITIAL_RETRY_DELAY_MS * Math.pow(2, attempt - 1);
      log.warn(`${operationName} failed (attempt ${attempt}/${MAX_RETRIES}), retrying in ${delay}ms`, {
        error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error),
      });
      
      await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, delay));
    }
  }
  
  throw lastError;
}

/**
 * Process array in batches to avoid Accelerate payload limits
 */
function chunk<T>(array: T[], size: number): T[][] {
  const chunks: T[][] = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < array.length; i += size) {
    chunks.push(array.slice(i, i + size));
  }
  return chunks;
}

/**
 * Resolve Clerk ID to Internal DB ID
 */
async function resolveUserId(prisma: EdgePrismaClient, clerkId: string): Promise<string> {
  const existingUser = await prisma.user.findUnique({
    where: { clerkId },
    select: { id: true },
  });

  if (existingUser) {
    return existingUser.id;
  }

  // User doesn't exist, create them
  const newUser = await prisma.user.create({
    data: {
      clerkId,
      email: `${clerkId}@placeholder.panacea.app`,
    },
    select: { id: true },
  });

  return newUser.id;
}

// ============================================================================
// HANDLERS
// ============================================================================

/**
 * GET /api/sync
 * Fetch user's data from the cloud
 */
export const onRequestGet = authenticatedEndpoint(
  GetSyncSchema,
  async (context) => {
    const log = createEndpointLogger('GET /api/sync', context.auth.userId);
    let prisma: EdgePrismaClient | null = null;

    try {
      prisma = createEdgePrismaClient(context.env.DATABASE_URL);

      // Resolve clerkId to internal userId
      const internalUserId = await resolveUserId(prisma, context.auth.userId);

      // Fetch all user data in parallel
      const [performanceRecords, srsItems, savedQuestions] = await Promise.all([
        prisma.performanceRecord.findMany({
          where: { userId: internalUserId },
        }),
        prisma.sRSItem.findMany({
          where: { userId: internalUserId },
        }),
        prisma.savedQuestion.findMany({
          where: { userId: internalUserId },
        }),
      ]);

      log.info('Sync data retrieved', {
        performanceRecords: performanceRecords.length,
        srsItems: srsItems.length,
        savedQuestions: savedQuestions.length,
      });

      type PerformanceRecordItem = (typeof performanceRecords)[0];
      return {
        data: {
          success: true,
          message: 'Data retrieved successfully',
          data: {
            performanceRecords: performanceRecords.map((r: PerformanceRecordItem) => ({
              ...r,
              timestamp: Number(r.timestamp),
            })),
            srsItems,
            savedQuestions,
          },
        },
      };
    } catch (error) {
      const errorMessage = error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error);
      log.error('Sync GET failed', { error: errorMessage, stack: error instanceof Error ? error.stack : undefined });
      return { status: 500, error: `Sync GET failed: ${errorMessage}` };
    } finally {
      await safePrismaDisconnect(prisma);
    }
  },
  { source: 'query' }
);

/**
 * POST /api/sync
 * Upload/merge local data to the cloud
 */
export const onRequestPost = authenticatedEndpoint(PostSyncSchema, async (context) => {
  const log = createEndpointLogger('POST /api/sync', context.auth.userId);
  let prisma: EdgePrismaClient | null = null;

  const payload = context.validated;

  // Verify user ID matches authenticated user
  if (payload.userId !== context.auth.userId) {
    log.warn('User ID mismatch', {
      expected: context.auth.userId,
      received: payload.userId,
    });
    return { status: 403, error: 'User ID mismatch' };
  }

  try {
    prisma = createEdgePrismaClient(context.env.DATABASE_URL);

    // Resolve user ID with retry for transient failures
    const internalUserId = await withRetry(
      () => resolveUserId(prisma!, context.auth.userId),
      'resolveUserId',
      log
    );

    // Process data in BATCHED transactions to avoid Accelerate payload limits
    // CRITICAL: Must stay under Cloudflare's 50 subrequest limit per request
    // Using bulk operations (createMany, updateMany) instead of per-item queries

    // 1. Insert PerformanceRecords using createMany with skipDuplicates
    // This is efficient because performance records are insert-only (no updates needed)
    if (payload.performanceRecords?.length) {
      const recordsToInsert = payload.performanceRecords.map(record => ({
        id: record.id || crypto.randomUUID(),
        userId: internalUserId,
        topic: record.topic,
        system: record.system || null,
        focus: record.focus,
        difficulty: record.difficulty,
        isCorrect: record.isCorrect,
        timestamp: BigInt(record.timestamp),
        questionWordCount: record.questionWordCount || null,
        errorTag: record.errorTag || null,
        subcategoryName: record.subcategoryName || null,
        conditionName: record.conditionName || null,
      }));

      // Process in chunks to avoid payload size limits
      const batches = chunk(recordsToInsert, BATCH_SIZE);
      for (const batch of batches) {
        await withRetry(
          () => prisma!.performanceRecord.createMany({
            data: batch,
            skipDuplicates: true, // Ignore records that already exist
          }),
          'performanceRecords createMany',
          log
        );
      }
    }

    // 2. SRSItems - Use a simplified approach: delete + insert for the user's items
    // This avoids per-item conflict resolution queries
    if (payload.srsItems?.length) {
      // Get all question IDs being synced
      const questionIds = payload.srsItems.map(item => item.questionId);
      
      // Delete existing records for these question IDs (single query)
      await withRetry(
        () => prisma!.sRSItem.deleteMany({
          where: {
            userId: internalUserId,
            questionId: { in: questionIds },
          },
        }),
        'srsItems deleteMany',
        log
      );

      // Insert all items fresh (single createMany per batch)
      const itemsToInsert = payload.srsItems.map(item => ({
        id: crypto.randomUUID(),
        userId: internalUserId,
        questionId: item.questionId,
        interval: item.interval,
        repetition: item.repetition,
        easiness: item.easiness,
        dueDate: new Date(item.dueDate),
        lastReviewed: new Date(item.lastReviewed),
        quality: item.quality,
        difficulty: item.difficulty !== undefined ? Number.parseFloat(String(item.difficulty)) : null,
        stabilityScore: item.stabilityScore ?? null,
        updatedAt: item.updatedAt ? new Date(item.updatedAt) : new Date(),
      }));

      const batches = chunk(itemsToInsert, BATCH_SIZE);
      for (const batch of batches) {
        await withRetry(
          () => prisma!.sRSItem.createMany({
            data: batch,
            skipDuplicates: true,
          }),
          'srsItems createMany',
          log
        );
      }
    }

    // 3. SavedQuestions - Same approach: delete + insert
    if (payload.savedQuestions?.length) {
      // Build the composite keys for deletion
      const keysToDelete = payload.savedQuestions
        .filter(item => {
          const questionText = item.questionText || item.question || '';
          return questionText.length > 0; // Only process items with content
        })
        .map(item => ({
          questionId: item.questionId || item.id || '',
          type: item.type,
        }))
        .filter(k => k.questionId); // Filter out empty IDs

      if (keysToDelete.length > 0) {
        // Delete existing records for these question IDs and types
        // Prisma doesn't support deleteMany with composite keys, so we use OR conditions
        const deleteConditions = keysToDelete.map(k => ({
          userId: internalUserId,
          questionId: k.questionId,
          type: k.type,
        }));

        await withRetry(
          () => prisma!.savedQuestion.deleteMany({
            where: {
              OR: deleteConditions,
            },
          }),
          'savedQuestions deleteMany',
          log
        );
      }

      // Insert all items fresh
      const itemsToInsert = payload.savedQuestions
        .map(item => {
          const questionId = item.questionId || item.id || crypto.randomUUID();
          const questionText = item.questionText || item.question || '';
          const correctAnswer = item.correctAnswer || 
            (item.options && item.correctAnswerIndex !== undefined 
              ? item.options[item.correctAnswerIndex] 
              : '');
          const explanation = item.explanation || item.rationale || '';
          const topic = item.topic || item.condition || '';

          if (!questionText) return null;

          return {
            id: crypto.randomUUID(),
            userId: internalUserId,
            questionId,
            questionText,
            correctAnswer,
            explanation,
            topic,
            system: item.system ?? null,
            type: item.type,
            userNote: item.userNote ?? null,
            repetitionLevel: item.repetitionLevel ?? null,
            nextReviewDate: item.nextReviewDate ?? null,
            updatedAt: item.updatedAt ? new Date(item.updatedAt) : new Date(),
          };
        })
        .filter((item): item is NonNullable<typeof item> => item !== null);

      if (itemsToInsert.length > 0) {
        const batches = chunk(itemsToInsert, BATCH_SIZE);
        for (const batch of batches) {
          await withRetry(
            () => prisma!.savedQuestion.createMany({
              data: batch,
              skipDuplicates: true,
            }),
            'savedQuestions createMany',
            log
          );
        }
      }
    }

    // Fetch updated data with retry (3 queries in parallel)
    const [performanceRecords, srsItems, savedQuestions] = await withRetry(
      () => Promise.all([
        prisma!.performanceRecord.findMany({
          where: { userId: internalUserId },
        }),
        prisma!.sRSItem.findMany({
          where: { userId: internalUserId },
        }),
        prisma!.savedQuestion.findMany({
          where: { userId: internalUserId },
        }),
      ]),
      'fetchUpdatedData',
      log
    );

    log.info('Sync completed', {
      performanceRecords: performanceRecords.length,
      srsItems: srsItems.length,
      savedQuestions: savedQuestions.length,
    });

    type PerformanceRecordResult = (typeof performanceRecords)[0];
    return {
      data: {
        success: true,
        message: 'Data synced successfully',
        data: {
          performanceRecords: performanceRecords.map((r: PerformanceRecordResult) => ({
            ...r,
            timestamp: Number(r.timestamp),
          })),
          srsItems,
          savedQuestions,
        },
      },
    };
  } catch (error) {
    const errorMessage = error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error);
    log.error('Sync POST failed', { error: errorMessage, stack: error instanceof Error ? error.stack : undefined });
    return { status: 500, error: `Sync POST failed: ${errorMessage}` };
  } finally {
    await safePrismaDisconnect(prisma);
  }
});

/**
 * OPTIONS handler for CORS preflight
 */
export const onRequestOptions = withCors();
````

## File: lib/prisma.ts
````typescript
/**
 * Prisma Client Singleton with Hybrid Configuration
 *
 * Handles the Prisma 7 + Accelerate "Catch-22":
 * - @prisma/extension-accelerate forces WASM engine
 * - WASM engine requires either Accelerate URL OR Driver Adapter
 *
 * Solution:
 * - Local (NODE_ENV=development): Use PG Adapter with direct postgres:// connection
 * - Production: Use Accelerate extension with prisma:// connection
 *
 * This allows us to keep Accelerate installed for production while still
 * working locally with a standard PostgreSQL connection.
 *
 * @see https://www.prisma.io/docs/guides/database/troubleshooting-orm/help-articles/nextjs-prisma-client-dev-practices
 * @see https://www.prisma.io/docs/accelerate
 * @see https://www.prisma.io/docs/orm/overview/databases/postgresql#driver-adapters
 */

import { PrismaClient } from '@prisma/client';
import { withAccelerate } from '@prisma/extension-accelerate';
import { Pool } from 'pg';
import { PrismaPg } from '@prisma/adapter-pg';

/**
 * Extended PrismaClient type that works with both development (PG Adapter)
 * and production (Accelerate) configurations.
 *
 * We use PrismaClient as the base type since both configurations expose
 * the same API - the only difference is internal implementation.
 */
type ExtendedPrismaClient = PrismaClient;

const globalForPrisma = globalThis as unknown as {
  prisma: ExtendedPrismaClient | undefined;
};

function createPrismaClient() {
  // Validate DATABASE_URL is present
  if (!process.env.DATABASE_URL) {
    const error = `
╔════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╗
║                   PRISMA CONFIGURATION ERROR                   ║
╚════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╝

❌ DATABASE_URL environment variable is not set!

This usually means:
  1. You're running 'npm run dev:all' locally but haven't set DATABASE_URL in .env
  2. The dotenv.config() call happened AFTER prisma was imported
  3. Your .env file is missing or corrupted

Fix:
  • Make sure DATABASE_URL is set in your .env file:
    DATABASE_URL="postgresql://user:password@host:5432/database"
  
  • For local development with npm run dev:all, you MUST have .env with DATABASE_URL
  • For Cloudflare deployment, set DATABASE_URL in your Cloudflare dashboard

Current working directory: ${process.cwd()}
NODE_ENV: ${process.env.NODE_ENV || 'undefined'}
`;
    throw new Error(error);
  }

  // Treat undefined NODE_ENV as development (default for local runs)
  // Also treat 'test' environment as development to use PG Adapter
  const isDevelopment = process.env.NODE_ENV === 'development' || process.env.NODE_ENV === 'test' || !process.env.NODE_ENV;
  const logLevel = isDevelopment ? ['query', 'error', 'warn'] : ['error'];

  // LOCAL DEVELOPMENT & TESTING: Use PG Adapter to satisfy WASM engine requirements
  if (isDevelopment) {
    const pool = new Pool({
      connectionString: process.env.DATABASE_URL,
    });

    const adapter = new PrismaPg(pool);

    return new PrismaClient({
      adapter,
      log: logLevel as any,
    });
  }

  // PRODUCTION: Use Accelerate extension with prisma:// URL
  const basePrisma = new PrismaClient({
    log: logLevel as any,
  });

  return basePrisma.$extends(withAccelerate());
}

export const prisma = (globalForPrisma.prisma ?? createPrismaClient()) as ExtendedPrismaClient;

if (process.env.NODE_ENV !== 'production') {
  globalForPrisma.prisma = prisma;
}

/**
 * Graceful shutdown handler
 */
export async function disconnectPrisma() {
  await prisma.$disconnect();
}
````

````prisma
model Condition {
  id                         String                       @id
  name                       String
  system                     String
  createdAt                  DateTime                     @default(now())
  updatedAt                  DateTime
  aliases                    String[]                     @default([])
  content                    Json?
  displayName                String?
  mediaUrl                   String?                      @map("media_url")
  parentId                   String?
  relatedSystems             String[]                     @default([])
  status                     String                       @default("published")
  subcategory                String?
  parent_category            String?
  AnatomyConditionLink       AnatomyConditionLink[]
  Condition                  Condition?                   @relation("ConditionToCondition", fields: [parentId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  other_Condition            Condition[]                  @relation("ConditionToCondition")
  DrugConditionLink          DrugConditionLink[]
  ECGConditionLink           ECGConditionLink[]
  FindingConditionLink       FindingConditionLink[]
  ImagingConditionLink       ImagingConditionLink[]
  LabConditionLink           LabConditionLink[]
  MediaAsset                 MediaAsset[]
  PhysiologyConditionLink    PhysiologyConditionLink[]
  ProcedureConditionLink     ProcedureConditionLink[]
  TreatmentConditionLink     TreatmentConditionLink[]
  AnatomyStructure           AnatomyStructure[]
  SpecialTest                SpecialTest[]
  // New deep relations
  DifferentialConditionLink  DifferentialConditionLink[]
  AntibioticConditionLink    AntibioticConditionLink[]
  VitalSignConditionLink     VitalSignConditionLink[]
  ScoringSystemConditionLink ScoringSystemConditionLink[]
  PearlConditionLink         PearlConditionLink[]
  ConditionRelation1         ConditionRelation[]          @relation("ConditionRelation1")
  ConditionRelation2         ConditionRelation[]          @relation("ConditionRelation2")
  Question                   Question[]
  ClinicalPearl              ClinicalPearl[]
  ScoringSystem              ScoringSystem[]
  ConfusionPairReal          ConfusionPair[]              @relation("ConfusionPairReal")
  ConfusionPairMistaken      ConfusionPair[]              @relation("ConfusionPairMistaken")
  WeaknessPattern            WeaknessPattern[]
  DifferentialDiagnosis      DifferentialDiagnosis[]
  PreGeneratedQuestion       PreGeneratedQuestion[]
  QuestionSeed               QuestionSeed[]
  SavedQuestion              SavedQuestion[]
  Guideline                  Guideline[]

  @@index([displayName])
  @@index([name])
  @@index([parentId])
  @@index([status])
  @@index([subcategory])
  @@index([system])
  @@index([parent_category])
  @@index([system, parent_category])
  @@index([system, subcategory, parent_category])
}

model ConfusionPair {
  id     String @id @default(cuid())
  userId String

  // Legacy string labels kept for compatibility with existing analytics/UI
  realCondition String
  mistakenFor   String

  count          Int      @default(1)
  lastOccurrence DateTime @updatedAt
  createdAt      DateTime @default(now())

  // Legacy Condition relations
  realConditionId   String?
  mistakenForId     String?
  RealCondition     Condition? @relation("ConfusionPairReal", fields: [realConditionId], references: [id], onDelete: SetNull)
  MistakenCondition Condition? @relation("ConfusionPairMistaken", fields: [mistakenForId], references: [id], onDelete: SetNull)

  // New MedicalContent-linked relations for precise comparisons
  correctConditionId  String?
  selectedConditionId String?
  CorrectCondition    MedicalContent? @relation("CorrectCondition", fields: [correctConditionId], references: [id], onDelete: SetNull)
  SelectedCondition   MedicalContent? @relation("SelectedCondition", fields: [selectedConditionId], references: [id], onDelete: SetNull)

  User User @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@unique([userId, realCondition, mistakenFor])
  @@unique([userId, correctConditionId, selectedConditionId])
  @@index([mistakenForId])
  @@index([realCondition])
  @@index([realConditionId])
  @@index([correctConditionId])
  @@index([selectedConditionId])
  @@index([userId])
  @@index([userId, correctConditionId])
  @@index([userId, realCondition])
}

model MediaAsset {

  // Relations
  Condition           Condition?            @relation(fields: [conditionId], references: [id])

  Procedure           Procedure?            @relation(fields: [procedureId], references: [id])

  @@index([approvalStatus])
  @@index([approvedAt])
  @@index([conditionId])
  @@index([difficulty])
  @@index([filename])
  @@index([folder])
  @@index([imagingStudyId])
  @@index([medicalContentId])
  @@index([drugId])
  @@index([procedureId])
  @@index([findingId])
  @@index([anatomyId])
  @@index([labTestId])
  @@index([mediaType])
  @@index([modality])
  @@index([status])
  @@index([tags])
  @@index([type])
  @@index([uploadedBy])
}

/// This model or at least one of its fields has comments in the database, and requires an additional setup for migrations: Read more: https://pris.ly/d/database-comments
model MedicalContent {
  id                    String                   @id
  conditionId           String                   @unique
  system                String
  subcategory           String
  condition             String
  status                String                   @default("draft")
  version               Int                      @default(1)
  createdAt             DateTime                 @default(now())
  createdBy             String
  updatedAt             DateTime
  updatedBy             String
  publishedAt           DateTime?
  publishedBy           String?
  approvedAt            DateTime?
  approvedBy            String?
  content               Json?
  relatedSystems        String[]                 @default([])
  parent_category       String?
  buzzwords             String[]                 @default([])
  complications         String?
  diagnostics           String?
  differentialDiagnosis String?
  epidemiology          String?
  etiology              String?
  overview              String?
  pathophysiology       String?
  physicalExam          String?
  prognosis             String?
  riskFactors           String?
  symptoms              String?
  treatment             String?
  classic_triad         Json?
  clinical_pearls       Json?
  first_line_rx         String?
  gold_standard_dx      String?
  age_demographic       Json?
  best_initial_test     String?
  classic_patient       String?
  differentials         Json?
  disposition           String?
  gender_bias           String?
  guidelines            String?
  image_query           String?
  mnemonic              String?
  pance_yield           Int?
  patient_education     String?
  prevention            String?
  synonyms              Json?
  search_vector         Unsupported("tsvector")?

  // Hierarchy fields
  parentId         String?
  relationshipType String? // "manifestation" | "subtype" | "complication" | "variant"
  canonicalName    String?

  // Hierarchy relations
  parent   MedicalContent?  @relation("ConditionHierarchy", fields: [parentId], references: [id])
  children MedicalContent[] @relation("ConditionHierarchy")

  // Inverse relations from junction tables with medicalContentId
  ContentAuditLog             ContentAuditLog[]
  ContentVersion              ContentVersion[]
  MedicalContentMedia         MedicalContentMedia[]
  AnatomyConditionLinks       AnatomyConditionLink[]
  DrugConditionLinks          DrugConditionLink[]
  ECGConditionLinks           ECGConditionLink[]
  FindingConditionLinks       FindingConditionLink[]
  ImagingConditionLinks       ImagingConditionLink[]
  LabConditionLinks           LabConditionLink[]
  PhysiologyConditionLinks    PhysiologyConditionLink[]
  ProcedureConditionLinks     ProcedureConditionLink[]
  TreatmentConditionLinks     TreatmentConditionLink[]
  DifferentialConditionLinks  DifferentialConditionLink[]
  AntibioticConditionLinks    AntibioticConditionLink[]
  VitalSignConditionLinks     VitalSignConditionLink[]
  ScoringSystemConditionLinks ScoringSystemConditionLink[]
  PearlConditionLinks         PearlConditionLink[]
  // Inverse relations from direct entity models with medicalContentId
  ClinicalPearls              ClinicalPearl[]
  MediaAssets                 MediaAsset[]
  Questions                   Question[]
  PreGeneratedQuestions       PreGeneratedQuestion[]
  QuestionSeeds               QuestionSeed[]
  SavedQuestions              SavedQuestion[]
  WeaknessPatterns            WeaknessPattern[]
  UserProgress                UserProgress[]
  ContentStatistics           ContentStatistics[]
  ConfusionPairsCorrect       ConfusionPair[]              @relation("CorrectCondition")
  ConfusionPairsSelected      ConfusionPair[]              @relation("SelectedCondition")
  ReviewLog                   ReviewLog[]

  @@index([conditionId])
  @@index([createdBy])
  @@index([relatedSystems])
  @@index([parentId])
  @@index([canonicalName])
  @@index([status])
  @@index([system])
  @@index([updatedAt])
  @@index([system, pance_yield])
  @@index([parent_category])
  @@index([system, parent_category])
  @@index([system, subcategory, parent_category])
  @@index([status, conditionId])
}

// =============================================================================
// UserProgress: DEPRECATED - Replaced by ReviewLog for performance (500ms → 5ms)
// The reviewHistory Json[] field is a major anti-pattern for large datasets
// TODO: Remove after confirming ReviewLog is fully operational
// =============================================================================
model UserProgress {
  id             String         @id @default(uuid())
  userId         String
  conditionId    String
  fsrsCard       Json
  fsrsParams     Json?
  reviewHistory  Json[]         @default([])
  totalAttempts  Int            @default(0)
  correctCount   Int            @default(0)
  accuracy       Float          @default(0)
  lastReviewAt   DateTime?
  nextReviewAt   DateTime?
  createdAt      DateTime       @default(now())
  updatedAt      DateTime       @updatedAt
  User           User           @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  MedicalContent MedicalContent @relation(fields: [conditionId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@unique([userId, conditionId])
  @@index([userId, nextReviewAt])
  @@index([conditionId])
  @@index([userId, conditionId])
}

// =============================================================================
// REVIEWLOG: High-Performance Time-Series Table for FSRS v6 Optimization
// Replaces UserProgress.reviewHistory Json[] for 100x speedup (500ms → 5ms)
// =============================================================================

model ReviewLog {
  id     String @id @default(cuid())
  userId String

  // Question/Content identification
  conditionId      String? // MedicalContent.conditionId
  medicalContentId String? // Direct FK to MedicalContent
  questionId       String? // Source question ID
  questionType     String? // 'pre_generated' | 'question' | 'seed'

  // FSRS v6 State Snapshot (at time of review)
  grade          Int // FSRS rating: 1 (Again), 2 (Hard), 3 (Good), 4 (Easy)
  state          Int // 0=New, 1=Learning, 2=Review, 3=Relearning
  stability      Float // S value at time of review
  difficulty     Float // D value at time of review
  retrievability Float? // R value at time of review (calculated)

  // Timing (critical for FSRS optimization)
  reviewedAt  DateTime  @default(now())
  scheduledAt DateTime? // When this review was scheduled
  elapsedDays Float? // Days since last review

  // Performance metrics
  responseTimeMs Int? // Time to answer (milliseconds)
  wasCorrect     Boolean // Actual correctness

  // Context
  sessionType SessionType @default(MAIN) // CRITICAL: Only MAIN sessions affect FSRS weights
  sessionId   String? // FK to StudySession
  attemptId   String? // FK to QuestionAttempt
  deviceType  String? // 'mobile' | 'tablet' | 'desktop'
  system      String? // Normalized system code (e.g., 'CV', 'PULM')
  telemetry   Json? // Compact behavioral metrics

  // Metadata
  fsrsVersion String   @default("6.0")
  createdAt   DateTime @default(now())

  // Relations
  User           User?           @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  MedicalContent MedicalContent? @relation(fields: [medicalContentId], references: [id], onDelete: SetNull)

  // === 8 CRITICAL INDEXES FOR FSRS OPTIMIZER ===
  // These indexes enable:
  // 1. Fast user review history queries (userId + time)
  // 2. Condition-specific review lookups (conditionId + time)
  // 3. System-level aggregations (system + time)
  // 4. FSRS state-based filtering (state, grade + time)
  @@index([userId, reviewedAt])
  @@index([userId, conditionId, reviewedAt])
  @@index([userId, system, reviewedAt])
  @@index([reviewedAt])
  @@index([conditionId, reviewedAt])
  @@index([medicalContentId])
  @@index([userId, state, reviewedAt])
  @@index([userId, sessionType, reviewedAt]) // CRITICAL: Fast filtering of MAIN sessions
  @@index([userId, grade, reviewedAt])
}

model PreGeneratedQuestion {
  id               String    @id
  questionType     String
  system           String?
  conditionId      String?
  medicalContentId String?
  difficulty       String
  questionData     Json
  generatedAt      DateTime  @default(now())
  usedAt           DateTime?
  usedBy           String?
  quality          Int?

  // Quality scoring (Phase 3)
  qualityScore      Float? // AI-assessed quality 0-100
  conditionAccuracy Float? // How well question tests the linked condition 0-1
  contentRelevance  Float? // How relevant to PANCE content 0-1
  distracorQuality  Float? // Quality of wrong answer options 0-1

  // Validation tracking
  validatedAt      DateTime? // When human validated
  validatedBy      String? // Admin userId who validated
  validationStatus String    @default("pending") // 'pending' | 'approved' | 'rejected' | 'needs_revision'
  validationNotes  String? // Admin notes on quality

  // Usage statistics
  timesServed    Int    @default(0) // How many times served to users
  timesCorrect   Int    @default(0) // Times answered correctly
  timesIncorrect Int    @default(0) // Times answered incorrectly
  avgTimeMs      Int? // Average time to answer
  flagCount      Int    @default(0) // Number of times flagged by users
  flagRate       Float? // flagCount / timesServed

  // Duplicate detection
  semanticHash       String? // Hash for duplicate detection
  similarQuestionIds String[] @default([]) // IDs of similar questions

  // FK relations
  Condition      Condition?      @relation(fields: [conditionId], references: [id], onDelete: SetNull)
  MedicalContent MedicalContent? @relation(fields: [medicalContentId], references: [id], onDelete: SetNull)

  @@index([conditionId])
  @@index([medicalContentId])
  @@index([difficulty])
  @@index([generatedAt])
  @@index([questionType])
  @@index([system])
  @@index([usedAt])
  @@index([validationStatus])
  @@index([qualityScore])
  @@index([flagRate])
}

  conditionId      String?

model QuestionAttempt {
  id                 String   @id
  userId             String
  questionId         String
  questionType       String?
  system             String?
  conditionId        String?
  mode               String?
  wasCorrect         Boolean  @default(false)
  isRankedAttempt    Boolean  @default(false)
  timeSpentMs        Int? // Time spent on question in milliseconds
  answerChangedCount Int? // Number of times answer was changed before submission
  createdAt          DateTime @default(now())

  // Rolling 360 Support
  isMainSession    Boolean @default(false) // True for Main Session mode only
  systemNormalized String? // Pre-computed normalized system name for fast aggregation

  // Phase 3: Telemetry Injection (Cognitive Fidelity)
  telemetryJson Json? // Detailed behavioral telemetry: MVRT, time_to_first_interaction, rapid_guess, etc.
  durationMs    Int? // Total duration from question display to submission (ms)

  @@index([isRankedAttempt])
  @@index([mode])
  @@index([questionId])
  @@index([userId, createdAt])
  @@index([system])
  @@index([userId, isMainSession, createdAt])
  // === 7 ADDITIONAL INDEXES FOR ROLLING 360 ANALYTICS ===
  // These indexes enable:
  // 1. Fast DESC sorting for latest attempts
  // 2. System-specific performance queries
  // 3. Correctness-based filtering
  // 4. Question type analytics
  // 5. Mode-based performance tracking
  // 6. Global time-series queries
  // 7. Condition-specific tracking
  @@index([userId, isMainSession, createdAt(sort: Desc)], map: "QuestionAttempt_userId_isMainSession_createdAt_desc_idx")
  @@index([userId, systemNormalized, createdAt])
  @@index([userId, wasCorrect, createdAt])
  @@index([userId, questionType, createdAt])
  @@index([userId, mode, createdAt])
  @@index([createdAt(sort: Desc)])
  @@index([conditionId, createdAt])
}

model SRSItem {
  id             String    @id
  userId         String
  questionId     String
  interval       Int
  repetition     Int
  easiness       Float
  dueDate        DateTime
  lastReviewed   DateTime
  quality        Int
  difficulty     Float
  stabilityScore Float
  createdAt      DateTime  @default(now())
  updatedAt      DateTime
  fsrsDifficulty Float?
  fsrsLastReview DateTime?
  fsrsStability  Float?
  fsrsState      Int       @default(0)
  User           User      @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@unique([userId, questionId])
  @@index([questionId])
  @@index([userId, dueDate])
  @@index([userId])
}

// =============================================================================
// CARD: FSRS v6 Compliant Model (Replaces SRSItem)
// Matches ts-fsrs Card interface exactly for seamless integration
// =============================================================================
model Card {
  id         String @id @default(cuid())
  userId     String
  questionId String // Connects to Question/MedicalContent

  // FSRS v6 State (matches ts-fsrs Card interface)
  due            DateTime // Next review date
  stability      Float     @default(0.0) // S - memory stability in days
  difficulty     Float     @default(0.0) // D - item difficulty [0-10]
  elapsed_days   Float     @default(0.0) // Days since card creation
  scheduled_days Float     @default(0.0) // Days until next review
  reps           Int       @default(0) // Total review count
  lapses         Int       @default(0) // Number of failed reviews
  state          Int       @default(0) // 0=New, 1=Learning, 2=Review, 3=Relearning
  last_review    DateTime? // Timestamp of last review

  // Metadata
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt DateTime @updatedAt

  // Relations
  user User @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@unique([userId, questionId])
  @@index([userId, due]) // CRITICAL: Fast "Due Today" queries
  @@index([userId, state]) // Filter by learning state
  @@index([questionId]) // Lookup by content
}

model SavedQuestion {
  id               String          @id
  userId           String
  questionId       String
  questionText     String
  correctAnswer    String
  explanation      String
  topic            String
  system           String?
  type             String
  userNote         String?
  repetitionLevel  Int             @default(1)
  nextReviewDate   String?
  createdAt        DateTime        @default(now())
  updatedAt        DateTime
  // New FK for deep relations
  conditionId      String?
  medicalContentId String?
  Condition        Condition?      @relation(fields: [conditionId], references: [id], onDelete: SetNull)
  MedicalContent   MedicalContent? @relation(fields: [medicalContentId], references: [id], onDelete: SetNull)
  User             User            @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@unique([userId, questionId, type])
  @@index([conditionId])
  @@index([medicalContentId])
  @@index([questionId])
  @@index([userId])
  @@index([userId, type])
}

model ScoringSystem {
  id                         String                       @id
  name                       String                       @unique
  displayName                String?
  aliases                    String[]                     @default([])
  category                   String
  condition                  String?
  panceYield                 Int?
  isHighYield                Boolean                      @default(false)
  boardYieldFacts            String[]                     @default([])
  components                 Json
  maxScore                   Int?
  minScore                   Int?                         @default(0)
  interpretation             Json
  actionThresholds           Json?
  sensitivity                Float?
  specificity                Float?
  validationStudies          String[]                     @default([])
  limitations                String[]                     @default([])
  whenToUse                  String?
  whenNotToUse               String[]                     @default([])
  clinicalContext            String?
  clinicalPearls             String[]                     @default([])
  commonMistakes             String[]                     @default([])
  testQuestionTips           String[]                     @default([])
  mnemonics                  String[]                     @default([])
  calculatorUrl              String?
  createdAt                  DateTime                     @default(now())
  updatedAt                  DateTime
  // New FK for deep relations
  conditionId                String?
  Condition                  Condition?                   @relation(fields: [conditionId], references: [id], onDelete: SetNull)
  ScoringSystemConditionLink ScoringSystemConditionLink[]

  @@index([category])
  @@index([condition])
  @@index([conditionId])
  @@index([panceYield])
}

model SemanticCache {
  id             String   @id
  queryText      String
  queryEmbedding String?
  questionType   String
  system         String?
  difficulty     String?
  cachedQuestion Json
  generatedAt    DateTime @default(now())
  lastUsedAt     DateTime @default(now())
  useCount       Int      @default(1)
  qualityScore   Float    @default(0)

  @@index([lastUsedAt])
  @@index([queryText(ops: raw("gin_trgm_ops"))], type: Gin)
  @@index([questionType])
  @@index([system])
}

model SpecialTest {

  region         String?

  positiveTest   String?
  interpretation String?
  imageUrl       String?
  videoUrl       String?
  createdAt      DateTime    @default(now())
  updatedAt      DateTime

  @@index([displayName])
  @@index([name])
}

model StagingQuestion {

  difficulty       String
  status           String   @default("pending")

model StudyGroup {
  id               String             @id
  name             String
  code             String             @unique
  description      String?
  ownerId          String
  isPublic         Boolean            @default(false)
  createdAt        DateTime           @default(now())

}

model StudyGroupMember {
  id         String     @id
  userId     String
  groupId    String
  role       String     @default("member")

  StudyGroup StudyGroup @relation(fields: [groupId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

model SyncQueue {
  id               String    @id
  userId           String

  data             Json
  status           String    @default("pending")
  attempts         Int       @default(0)
  createdAt        DateTime  @default(now())
  syncedAt         DateTime?
  error            String?
  conflictDetected Boolean   @default(false)
  lastError        String?
  maxRetries       Int       @default(5)
  version          Int       @default(1)

  @@index([attempts])
  @@index([createdAt])
  @@index([status])
  @@index([userId])
}

model Treatment {
  id                     String                   @id
  name                   String                   @unique
  displayName            String?
  category               String
  type                   String?
  description            String?
  indications            String[]
  contraindications      String[]
  complications          String[]
  createdAt              DateTime                 @default(now())
  updatedAt              DateTime
  advantages             String[]                 @default([])
  alternativeTo          String[]                 @default([])
  boardYieldFacts        String[]                 @default([])
  clinicalPearls         String[]                 @default([])
  commonMistakes         String[]                 @default([])
  disadvantages          String[]                 @default([])
  duration               String?
  evidenceLevel          String?
  followUp               String?

model Guideline {
  id               String     @id
  name             String
  type             String // 'screening', 'prevention', 'treatment'
  organization     String? // 'USPSTF', 'AHA', 'IDSA'
  conditionId      String?
  criteria         Json? // age, risk factors, frequency
  grade            String? // A, B, C, D, I
  frequency        String?
  targetPopulation String?
  evidenceLevel    String?
  panceYield       Int?
  createdAt        DateTime   @default(now())
  updatedAt        DateTime   @updatedAt
  Condition        Condition? @relation(fields: [conditionId], references: [id], onDelete: SetNull)

  @@index([type])
  @@index([organization])
  @@index([panceYield])
  @@index([conditionId])
}

model PlatformStatistics {
  id                     String   @id
  date                   DateTime @unique @db.Date
  dau                    Int      @default(0)
  wau                    Int      @default(0)
  mau                    Int      @default(0)
  newUsers               Int      @default(0)
  returningUsers         Int      @default(0)
  retention7Day          Decimal? @db.Decimal(5, 4)
  retention30Day         Decimal? @db.Decimal(5, 4)
  questionsAnswered      Int      @default(0)
  questionsCorrect       Int      @default(0)
  questionsIncorrect     Int      @default(0)
  averageAccuracy        Decimal? @db.Decimal(5, 4)
  sessionsStarted        Int      @default(0)
  sessionsCompleted      Int      @default(0)
  averageSessionDuration Int?
  totalStudyTime         Int      @default(0)
  fsrsCardsReviewed      Int      @default(0)
  fsrsCardsMature        Int      @default(0)
  fsrsAverageRetention   Decimal? @db.Decimal(5, 4)
  createdAt              DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt              DateTime @updatedAt

  @@index([date])
  @@index([dau])
  @@index([createdAt])
}

  questionsCorrect  Int            @default(0)
  uniqueUsers       Int            @default(0)
  averageAccuracy   Decimal?       @db.Decimal(5, 4)
  averageTimeSpent  Int?

  flagCount         Int            @default(0)
  createdAt         DateTime       @default(now())
  updatedAt         DateTime       @updatedAt

  @@unique([conditionId, date])
  @@index([conditionId])
  @@index([date])
  @@index([views])
  @@index([questionsAnswered])
  @@index([uniqueUsers])
}

model UserStatisticsSnapshot {
  id                   String   @id
  userId               String
  snapshotDate         DateTime @db.Date
  totalQuestions       Int      @default(0)
  correctAnswers       Int      @default(0)
  accuracy             Decimal? @db.Decimal(5, 4)
  currentStreak        Int      @default(0)
  longestStreak        Int      @default(0)
  totalStudyTime       Int      @default(0)
  conditionsMastered   Int      @default(0)
  fsrsCardsTotal       Int      @default(0)
  fsrsCardsMature      Int      @default(0)
  fsrsAverageRetention Decimal? @db.Decimal(5, 4)
  weakestSystem        String?
  strongestSystem      String?

  @@unique([userId, snapshotDate])
  @@index([userId])
  @@index([snapshotDate])
  @@index([accuracy])
}

model TreatmentConditionLink {
  id               String          @id
  treatmentId      String
  conditionId      String
  medicalContentId String?

  evidenceLevel    String?
  isFirstLine      Boolean         @default(false)
  notes            String?

  Condition        Condition       @relation(fields: [conditionId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  Treatment        Treatment       @relation(fields: [treatmentId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  MedicalContent   MedicalContent? @relation(fields: [medicalContentId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@unique([treatmentId, conditionId, relationshipType])
  @@index([conditionId])
  @@index([isFirstLine])
  @@index([medicalContentId])
  @@index([relationshipType])

model User {
  id                      String                    @id @default(uuid())
  clerkId                 String                    @unique
  email                   String                    @unique
  firstName               String?
  lastName                String?
  createdAt               DateTime                  @default(now())
  updatedAt               DateTime
  emailVerified           DateTime?
  resetToken              String?
  resetTokenExpiry        DateTime?
  verifyToken             String?
  verifyTokenExpiry       DateTime?
  hasCompletedBaseline    Boolean                   @default(false)
  hasCompletedOnboarding  Boolean                   @default(false)
  examDate                DateTime?
  graduationDate          DateTime?
  school                  String?
  currentRotation         String?
  yearInProgram           String?
  isAnonymous             Boolean                   @default(false)
  role                    UserRole                  @default(USER)
  CohortMember            CohortMember[]
  DailyStreak             DailyStreak[]
  GrandRoundsAttempt      GrandRoundsAttempt[]
  PatientEncounterSession PatientEncounterSession[]
  PeerStatistic           PeerStatistic[]
  PerformanceRecord       PerformanceRecord[]
  SRSItem                 SRSItem[]
  Card                    Card[] // FSRS v6 compliant cards
  SavedQuestion           SavedQuestion[]
  StudyGroupMember        StudyGroupMember[]
  UserAchievement         UserAchievement[]
  UserPearl               UserPearl[]
  UserQuestionHistory     UserQuestionHistory[]
  UserSRSConfig           UserSRSConfig?
  UserWordleState         UserWordleState[]
  UserTopicProgress       UserTopicProgress[]
  StudyRecommendation     StudyRecommendation[]
  ContrastiveDrillAttempt ContrastiveDrillAttempt[]
  UserProgress            UserProgress[]
  // New deep relations
  ConfusionPair           ConfusionPair[]
  WeaknessPattern         WeaknessPattern[]
  StudySession            StudySession[]
  UserLearningProfile     UserLearningProfile?
  UserQuestionSeen        UserQuestionSeen[]
  UserStatisticsSnapshot  UserStatisticsSnapshot[]
  UserBehaviorMetrics     UserBehaviorMetrics[]
  UserPreferences         UserPreferences?
  UserGoal                UserGoal[]
  UserConfusionPattern    UserConfusionPattern[]
  UserCircadianProfile    UserCircadianProfile?
  SessionAnalytics        SessionAnalytics[]
  PersonalizedFSRSParams  PersonalizedFSRSParams?
  UserStatistics          UserStatistics?
  UserRolling360Stats     UserRolling360Stats?
  ReviewLog               ReviewLog[]

  @@index([clerkId])
  @@index([email])
  @@index([role])
}

model UserStatistics {
  id     String @id @default(cuid())
  userId String @unique

  // Overall Performance
  totalQuestions     Int    @default(0)
  correctAnswers     Int    @default(0)
  avgTimePerQuestion Float?

  // System-level breakdown (stored as JSON for flexibility)
  systemStats Json?

  // Behavioral Patterns
  rushedSystems       String[] @default([])
  overthinkingSystems String[] @default([])

  // Diagnosis Bias (conditions frequently over-selected as wrong answers)
  diagnosisBias Json?

  // Strengths/Weaknesses (auto-calculated)
  strongestSystems String[] @default([])
  weakestSystems   String[] @default([])

  // Time tracking
  peakStudyHours   Int[]  @default([])
  avgSessionLength Float?

  updatedAt DateTime @updatedAt
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())

  User User @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@index([userId])
}

model UserAchievement {
  id            String   @id
  userId        String
  achievementId String
  unlockedAt    DateTime @default(now())
  progress      Int      @default(100)
  User          User     @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@unique([userId, achievementId])
  @@index([achievementId])
  @@index([userId])
}

model UserPearl {
  id            String        @id
  userId        String
  pearlId       String
  isSaved       Boolean       @default(false)
  savedAt       DateTime?
  viewedAt      DateTime?
  markedUseful  Boolean       @default(false)
  notes         String?
  ClinicalPearl ClinicalPearl @relation(fields: [pearlId], references: [id])
  User          User          @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id])

  @@unique([userId, pearlId])
}

model UserQuestionHistory {
  id         String   @id
  userId     String
  questionId String
  seenAt     DateTime @default(now())
  isCorrect  Boolean
  User       User     @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@unique([userId, questionId])
  @@index([userId])
}
````
