````prisma
model UserWordleState {
  id        String       @id
  userId    String
  date      DateTime     @db.Date
  guesses   String[]     @default([])
  status    WordleStatus @default(playing)
  updatedAt DateTime
  User      User         @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@unique([userId, date])
  @@index([date])
  @@index([userId])
}

model VitalSignRange {
  id                     String                   @id
  vitalSign              String                   @unique
  displayName            String?
  category               String
  normalRange            String?
  ranges                 Json?
  units                  String?
  elevation              Json?
  depression             Json?
  emergencyValues        Json?
  associatedConditions   Json?
  clinicalPearls         String[]                 @default([])
  commonMistakes         String[]                 @default([])
  testQuestionTips       String[]                 @default([])
  createdAt              DateTime                 @default(now())
  updatedAt              DateTime
  // New deep relations
  VitalSignConditionLink VitalSignConditionLink[]

  @@index([category])
}

model WeaknessPattern {
  id               String          @id
  userId           String
  conditionId      String
  medicalContentId String?
  wasCorrect       Boolean
  timestamp        DateTime        @default(now())
  consecutiveWrong Int             @default(0)
  // New FKs for deep relations
  User             User?           @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  Condition        Condition?      @relation(fields: [conditionId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  MedicalContent   MedicalContent? @relation(fields: [medicalContentId], references: [id], onDelete: SetNull)

  @@index([conditionId])
  @@index([medicalContentId])
  @@index([userId, conditionId])
  @@index([userId])
}

// =============================================================================
// NEW JUNCTION TABLES FOR DEEP FOREIGN KEY RELATIONSHIPS
// =============================================================================

/// Links DifferentialDiagnosis to multiple conditions
model DifferentialConditionLink {
  id                     String                @id
  differentialId         String
  conditionId            String
  medicalContentId       String?
  rankOrder              Int                   @default(0)
  likelihood             String? // 'common', 'less_common', 'rare', 'must_not_miss'
  distinguishingFeatures String?
  createdAt              DateTime              @default(now())
  updatedAt              DateTime              @default(now())
  DifferentialDiagnosis  DifferentialDiagnosis @relation(fields: [differentialId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  Condition              Condition             @relation(fields: [conditionId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  MedicalContent         MedicalContent?       @relation(fields: [medicalContentId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@unique([differentialId, conditionId])
  @@index([differentialId])
  @@index([conditionId])
  @@index([medicalContentId])
  @@index([likelihood])
}

/// Links antibiotics to conditions they treat
model AntibioticConditionLink {
  id                  String              @id
  antibioticId        String
  conditionId         String
  medicalContentId    String?
  isFirstLine         Boolean             @default(false)
  evidenceLevel       String?
  dosing              String?
  duration            String?
  notes               String?
  createdAt           DateTime            @default(now())
  updatedAt           DateTime            @default(now())
  AntibioticGuideline AntibioticGuideline @relation(fields: [antibioticId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  Condition           Condition           @relation(fields: [conditionId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  MedicalContent      MedicalContent?     @relation(fields: [medicalContentId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@unique([antibioticId, conditionId])
  @@index([antibioticId])
  @@index([conditionId])
  @@index([medicalContentId])
  @@index([isFirstLine])
}

/// Links vital signs to conditions that affect them
model VitalSignConditionLink {
  id                   String          @id
  vitalSignId          String
  conditionId          String
  medicalContentId     String?
  expectedChange       String? // 'elevated', 'decreased', 'variable'
  typicalRange         String?
  clinicalSignificance String?
  isEmergency          Boolean         @default(false)
  createdAt            DateTime        @default(now())
  updatedAt            DateTime        @default(now())
  VitalSignRange       VitalSignRange  @relation(fields: [vitalSignId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  Condition            Condition       @relation(fields: [conditionId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  MedicalContent       MedicalContent? @relation(fields: [medicalContentId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@unique([vitalSignId, conditionId])
  @@index([vitalSignId])
  @@index([conditionId])
  @@index([medicalContentId])
  @@index([isEmergency])
}

/// Links scoring systems to conditions they evaluate
model ScoringSystemConditionLink {
  id               String          @id
  scoringSystemId  String
  conditionId      String
  medicalContentId String?
  usageContext     String? // 'diagnosis', 'prognosis', 'risk_stratification'
  createdAt        DateTime        @default(now())
  updatedAt        DateTime        @default(now())
  ScoringSystem    ScoringSystem   @relation(fields: [scoringSystemId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  Condition        Condition       @relation(fields: [conditionId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  MedicalContent   MedicalContent? @relation(fields: [medicalContentId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@unique([scoringSystemId, conditionId])
  @@index([scoringSystemId])
  @@index([conditionId])
  @@index([medicalContentId])
}

/// Links clinical pearls to conditions
model PearlConditionLink {
  id               String          @id
  pearlId          String
  conditionId      String
  medicalContentId String?
  relevance        String? // 'diagnostic', 'therapeutic', 'general'
  createdAt        DateTime        @default(now())
  updatedAt        DateTime        @default(now())
  ClinicalPearl    ClinicalPearl   @relation(fields: [pearlId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  Condition        Condition       @relation(fields: [conditionId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  MedicalContent   MedicalContent? @relation(fields: [medicalContentId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@unique([pearlId, conditionId])
  @@index([pearlId])
  @@index([conditionId])
  @@index([medicalContentId])
}

// =============================================================================
// NEW MODELS FOR "SECOND CHANCE" SYSTEM
// =============================================================================

model QuestionVariant {
  id             String @id @default(cuid())
  baseQuestionId String // Link to original Question or conditionId
  variantType    String // "rephrased" | "different_distractors" | "different_vitals" | "different_scenario"

  // Question content
  vignette      String?
  question      String
  options       String[] // 4 answer choices
  correctAnswer String
  explanation   String

  // Metadata
  difficulty String  @default("medium")
  taskType   String? // "diagnosis" | "treatment" | "mechanism" | "next_step"

  usedByUsers String[] // UserIds who have seen this variant
  createdAt   DateTime @default(now())

  @@index([baseQuestionId])
  @@index([taskType])
}

model UserTopicProgress {
  id          String @id @default(cuid())
  userId      String
  conditionId String // MedicalContent ID
  taskType    String // "diagnosis" | "treatment" | "mechanism" | "workup" | "prevention"

  // FSRS state per topic
  stability      Float     @default(1.0)
  difficulty     Float     @default(5.0)
  lastReviewDate DateTime?
  nextReviewDate DateTime?
  state          Int       @default(0) // 0=New, 1=Learning, 2=Review, 3=Relearning
  reps           Int       @default(0)
  lapses         Int       @default(0)

  // Track variants used
  variantsUsed String[] // QuestionVariant IDs already shown

  createdAt DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt DateTime @updatedAt

  User User @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@unique([userId, conditionId, taskType])
  @@index([userId, nextReviewDate])
}

model StudyRecommendation {
  id          String    @id @default(cuid())
  userId      String
  type        String // "drill_session" | "review" | "new_topic"
  topic       String // e.g., "Cardiology", "Beta Blockers" (or conditionId)
  reason      String // "Fading memory", "Low accuracy"
  priority    String // "high", "medium", "low"
  status      String // "pending", "completed", "dismissed"
  data        Json? // Optional context (e.g., list of question IDs)
  createdAt   DateTime  @default(now())
  completedAt DateTime?

  User User @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@index([userId, status])
  @@index([userId, priority])
}

/// Drug-drug interactions (self-referential many-to-many)
model DrugInteraction {
  id                String   @id
  drugId1           String
  drugId2           String
  severity          String // 'major', 'moderate', 'minor'
  mechanism         String?
  clinicalEffect    String?
  management        String?
  isContraindicated Boolean  @default(false)
  createdAt         DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt         DateTime @default(now())
  Drug1             Drug     @relation("DrugInteraction1", fields: [drugId1], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  Drug2             Drug     @relation("DrugInteraction2", fields: [drugId2], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@unique([drugId1, drugId2])
  @@index([drugId1])
  @@index([drugId2])
  @@index([severity])
}

/// Condition-to-condition relationships (differentials, complications, etc.)
model ConditionRelation {
  id              String    @id
  conditionId1    String
  conditionId2    String
  relationType    String // 'differential', 'complication', 'precursor', 'associated'
  bidirectional   Boolean   @default(true)
  clinicalContext String?
  createdAt       DateTime  @default(now())
  Condition1      Condition @relation("ConditionRelation1", fields: [conditionId1], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  Condition2      Condition @relation("ConditionRelation2", fields: [conditionId2], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@unique([conditionId1, conditionId2, relationType])
  @@index([conditionId1])
  @@index([conditionId2])
  @@index([relationType])
}

enum CohortRole {
  ADMIN
  MEMBER
}

enum UserRole {
  USER
  VIEWER
  EDITOR
  APPROVER
  ADMIN
  SUPERADMIN
}

enum WordleStatus {
  playing
  won
  lost
}

enum SessionType {
  MAIN // Only these count for FSRS optimization
  CRAM // Practice mode - excluded from stats
  RAPID_RECALL // Quick review - excluded from stats
}

// ============================================================================
// Sprint 4: Enhanced Session Analytics
// ============================================================================

model StudySession {
  id        String    @id
  userId    String
  startedAt DateTime  @default(now())
  endedAt   DateTime?

  // Core metrics
  totalQuestions     Int   @default(0)
  correctAnswers     Int   @default(0)
  accuracy           Float @default(0)
  totalTimeMs        Int   @default(0)
  avgTimePerQuestion Int?

  // Streak data
  bestStreak    Int    @default(0)
  finalStreak   Int    @default(0)
  avgStreak     Float?
  errorClusters Int    @default(0) // Count of 3+ errors in 5 questions

  // Momentum metrics
  peakMomentum  Float? // Highest momentum reached (0-100)
  avgMomentum   Float?
  momentumTrend String? // 'peaked' | 'rising' | 'steady' | 'cooling' | 'cold'

  // Behavioral signals
  totalAnswerChanges    Int    @default(0)
  helpfulChanges        Int    @default(0) // Changed to correct
  harmfulChanges        Int    @default(0) // Changed to wrong
  firstInstinctAccuracy Float? // Accuracy if never changed answers

  // Confidence calibration
  avgInferredConfidence  Float? // Average behavioral confidence
  highConfidenceAccuracy Float? // Accuracy when high confidence
  lowConfidenceAccuracy  Float? // Accuracy when low confidence
  calibrationScore       Float? // How well confidence matches accuracy

  // Time pressure analysis
  questionsUnderPar  Int    @default(0)
  questionsOverPar   Int    @default(0)
  rushingAccuracy    Float? // Accuracy when under 60% of par time
  deliberateAccuracy Float? // Accuracy when over par time

  // Fatigue indicators
  early10Accuracy Float? // First 10 questions accuracy
  late10Accuracy  Float? // Last 10 questions accuracy
  staminaFade     Float? // Difference (negative = fatigue)

  // PANCE distribution
  distributionScore Float? // How closely session matched PANCE blueprint
  systemsCovered    String[] @default([]) // Systems practiced
  systemsTargeted   String[] @default([]) // Explicitly selected systems for the session

  // Predicted score
  predictedScore  Int? // Estimated PANCE score (200-800)
  scoreConfidence String? // 'low' | 'medium' | 'high'
  passLikelihood  Float? // 0-100%

  // Session settings
  sessionType String? // 'mixed' | 'focused' | 'review'
  mode        String? // 'drill' | 'review' | 'exam'
  focus       String? // 'new' | 'review' | 'missed'
  difficulty  String? // 'easy' | 'medium' | 'hard' | 'random'

  // Metadata & Context (Step 7: Session Context Tracking)
  deviceType     String? // 'mobile' | 'tablet' | 'desktop'
  browserName    String?
  screenSize     String? // e.g., "1920x1080"
  connectionType String? // 'wifi' | 'cellular' | 'unknown'
  likelyContext  String? // 'commute' | 'home' | 'library' | 'unknown'
  isQuickSession Boolean @default(false) // < 10 questions
  wasInterrupted Boolean @default(false) // Large gaps detected

  createdAt DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt DateTime @updatedAt

  // New FK for deep relations
  User             User?             @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  SessionAnalytics SessionAnalytics?

  @@index([userId])
  @@index([userId, startedAt])
  @@index([startedAt])
}

model UserLearningProfile {
  id     String @id
  userId String @unique

  // Cumulative performance
  lifetimeQuestions   Int    @default(0)
  lifetimeCorrect     Int    @default(0)
  lifetimeAccuracy    Float  @default(0)
  lifetimeStudyTimeMs BigInt @default(0)

  // Streak records
  bestEverStreak     Int @default(0)
  currentStreak      Int @default(0) // Consecutive days studied
  longestDailyStreak Int @default(0)

  // Test-taking patterns (aggregated)
  avgAnswerChanges        Float?
  changeHelpfulRatio      Float? // Ratio of helpful to total changes
  firstInstinctTrustScore Float? // Should they trust first instinct?

  // Confidence calibration (lifetime)
  overallCalibrationScore Float?
  overconfidenceIndex     Float? // How often high confidence = wrong
  underconfidenceIndex    Float? // How often low confidence = right

  // Time patterns
  avgTimePerQuestion Int?
  optimalTimeRange   String? // e.g., "45-75 seconds"
  rushingTendency    Float? // 0-1, higher = tends to rush

  // Stamina profile
  avgSessionLength     Int? // Questions per session
  fatigueOnsetQuestion Int? // When accuracy typically drops
  optimalSessionLength Int? // Recommended questions per session

  // System strengths/weaknesses
  strongestSystems   String[] @default([])
  weakestSystems     String[] @default([])
  mostImprovedSystem String?

  // PANCE readiness
  estimatedScore Int? // Rolling PANCE estimate
  scoreHistory   Json? // Array of {date, score, confidence}
  readinessLevel String? // 'not_ready' | 'progressing' | 'almost_ready' | 'ready'
  targetExamDate DateTime?

  // Learning style insights
  learningInsights String[] @default([]) // AI-generated insights
  recommendations  String[] @default([]) // Personalized recommendations

  // Circadian patterns
  bestStudyHour    Int? // 0-23, best performance hour
  worstStudyHour   Int? // 0-23, worst performance hour
  weekendVsWeekday Float? // Performance difference

  createdAt DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt DateTime @updatedAt

  // New FK for deep relations
  User User? @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@index([userId])
  @@index([estimatedScore])
}

// =============================================================================
// NORMAL REFERENCE VALUES
// Stores normal lab values and imaging findings for case generation
// =============================================================================

model NormalLabValue {
  id          String  @id @default(cuid())
  labTestId   String?
  labTestName String // e.g., "Hemoglobin", "BUN", "Sodium"
  category    String // e.g., "CBC", "BMP", "LFT", "Lipid Panel", "Cardiac Markers"

  // Normal ranges
  normalRangeLow  Float?
  normalRangeHigh Float?
  normalRangeText String? // For qualitative results like "Negative"
  units           String? // e.g., "g/dL", "mg/dL", "mEq/L"

  // SI Units conversion
  siUnits          String?
  siRangeLow       Float?
  siRangeHigh      Float?
  conversionFactor Float?

  // Demographics for different ranges
  sex          String? // 'male', 'female', 'all'
  ageGroup     String? // 'neonate', 'infant', 'child', 'adult', 'elderly'
  ageRangeLow  Int? // Age in years
  ageRangeHigh Int? // Age in years

  // Critical values (panic values)
  criticalLow  Float?
  criticalHigh Float?

  // Clinical context
  clinicalNotes String?
  commonCauses  String[] @default([]) // Causes of abnormal results

  // Metadata
  source         String? // e.g., "UpToDate", "Harrison's"
  lastVerified   DateTime?
  isHighYield    Boolean   @default(false)
  panceRelevance Int? // 1-5 relevance score

  createdAt DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt DateTime @updatedAt

  LabTest LabTest? @relation(fields: [labTestId], references: [id])

  @@unique([labTestName, sex, ageGroup])
  @@index([category])
  @@index([labTestId])
  @@index([labTestName])
  @@index([isHighYield])
}

model NormalImagingFinding {
  id               String  @id @default(cuid())
  imagingStudyId   String?
  imagingStudyName String // e.g., "Chest X-ray", "CT Head", "Echocardiogram"
  modality         String // e.g., "X-ray", "CT", "MRI", "Ultrasound", "Echo"
  bodyRegion       String // e.g., "Chest", "Abdomen", "Head", "Spine"

  // Normal finding description
  findingName       String // e.g., "Cardiac silhouette", "Lung fields", "Mediastinum"
  normalAppearance  String // Description of normal appearance
  normalMeasurement String? // e.g., "CTR < 0.5", "Aortic root < 4.0 cm"
  measurementUnit   String? // e.g., "cm", "mm", "ratio"
  measurementLow    Float?
  measurementHigh   Float?

  // View/Protocol specific
  view     String? // e.g., "PA", "Lateral", "AP", "Axial"
  protocol String? // e.g., "With contrast", "Without contrast"

  // Clinical context
  significance      String? // Why this finding matters
  abnormalIndicates String[] @default([]) // What abnormal suggests
  clinicalPearls    String[] @default([])

  // Metadata
  source         String?
  lastVerified   DateTime?
  isHighYield    Boolean   @default(false)
  panceRelevance Int?

  createdAt DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt DateTime @updatedAt

  ImagingStudy ImagingStudy? @relation(fields: [imagingStudyId], references: [id])

  @@unique([imagingStudyName, findingName, view])
  @@index([bodyRegion])
  @@index([imagingStudyId])
  @@index([modality])
  @@index([isHighYield])
}

model NormalVitalSign {
  id        String @id @default(cuid())
  vitalName String // e.g., "Heart Rate", "Blood Pressure", "Temperature"

  // Normal ranges
  normalRangeLow  Float?
  normalRangeHigh Float?
  units           String // e.g., "bpm", "mmHg", "°F", "breaths/min"

  // Demographics
  sex          String? // 'male', 'female', 'all'
  ageGroup     String? // 'neonate', 'infant', 'child', 'adult', 'elderly'
  ageRangeLow  Int?
  ageRangeHigh Int?

  // Context-specific variations
  context String? // e.g., "at rest", "sleeping", "exercising", "pregnant"

  // Clinical notes
  clinicalNotes     String?
  abnormalIndicates String[] @default([])

  createdAt DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt DateTime @updatedAt

  @@unique([vitalName, sex, ageGroup, context])
  @@index([vitalName])
  @@index([ageGroup])
}

model NormalPhysicalExamFinding {
  id            String @id @default(cuid())
  system        String // e.g., "Cardiovascular", "Respiratory", "Neurological"
  examComponent String // e.g., "Heart Sounds", "Breath Sounds", "Pupils"

  // Normal finding
  normalFinding String // e.g., "S1, S2 regular without murmurs"
  technique     String? // How to examine

  // Demographics
  ageGroup String?

  // Clinical context
  abnormalVariations String[] @default([]) // What abnormal looks like
  clinicalPearls     String[] @default([])

  createdAt DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt DateTime @updatedAt

  @@unique([system, examComponent, ageGroup])
  @@index([system])
  @@index([examComponent])
}

// =============================================================================
// QUESTION TRACKING IMPROVEMENTS
// Tracks which questions each user has seen to prevent repetition
// =============================================================================

/// Tracks which questions each user has seen for no-repeat functionality
model UserQuestionSeen {
  id           String @id @default(cuid())
  userId       String
  questionId   String // ID from Question, PreGeneratedQuestion, etc.
  questionType String // 'question' | 'pre_generated' | 'seed' | 'staging'

  // Timing
  firstSeenAt DateTime @default(now())
  lastSeenAt  DateTime @default(now())
  timesShown  Int      @default(1)

  // Performance on this specific question
  timesCorrect   Int  @default(0)
  timesIncorrect Int  @default(0)
  avgTimeMs      Int? // Average time to answer
  lastAnswerMs   Int? // Most recent answer time

  // Was the question answered correctly on first attempt?
  correctOnFirst Boolean?

  // User relation
  User User @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  createdAt DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt DateTime @updatedAt

  @@unique([userId, questionId, questionType])
  @@index([userId, questionType])
  @@index([userId, lastSeenAt])
  @@index([questionId])
  @@index([questionType])
}

// Sprint C - Step 8: Question Versioning
model QuestionVersion {
  id           String @id @default(cuid())
  questionId   String // References PreGeneratedQuestion or Question
  questionType String // 'pre_generated' | 'question' | 'staging'
  version      Int // Version number (1, 2, 3, ...)

  // Snapshot of question data at this version
  questionData Json // Full question snapshot

  // Change tracking
  changedFields String[] // Array of field names that changed
  changeReason  String? // Why was this edit made?
  changeSummary String? // Brief description of changes

  // Editor info
  editedBy      String // User ID who made the edit
  editedByEmail String? // User email for audit trail

  // Validation scores
  distractorScore Int? // Score from distractor validation (0-100)
  qualityScore    Int? // Overall quality score (0-100)

  // Timestamps
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())

  @@unique([questionId, questionType, version])
  @@index([questionId, version])
  @@index([questionId, questionType])
  @@index([editedBy])
  @@index([createdAt])
}

// User Data Improvement Plan - Sprint A

// Step 1: Persist Implicit Behavioral Metrics
model UserBehaviorMetrics {
  id           String  @id @default(cuid())
  userId       String
  questionId   String
  questionType String? // 'pre_generated' | 'question' | 'staging'

  // Core timing metrics
  timeToFirstClick  Int // Time from display to first selection (ms)
  dwellTime         Int // Total time on question before submission (ms)
  totalResponseTime Int // Total time including pauses (ms)

  // Interaction patterns
  answerChanges Int  @default(0) // Number of times answer was changed
  optionHovers  Int  @default(0) // Number of option hover events
  scrollDepth   Int? // Max scroll depth percentage (0-100)

  // Behavioral signals
  hesitationEvents Int @default(0) // Pauses > 3 seconds
  backtrackCount   Int @default(0) // Times returned to previous options

  // Context
  timeOfDay       Int // Hour of day (0-23)
  deviceType      String? // 'mobile' | 'tablet' | 'desktop'
  wasCorrect      Boolean
  confidenceLevel Int? // 1-5 if collected

  // FSRS derivation
  derivedRating    Int? // FSRS rating (1-4) derived from behavior
  ratingConfidence Float? // Confidence in derived rating (0-1)

  // Advanced metrics (optional)
  trajectoryData Json? // Mouse trajectory metrics
  typingRhythm   Json? // Keystroke timing patterns

  // Relations
  User User @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  createdAt DateTime @default(now())

  @@index([userId, createdAt])
  @@index([questionId])
  @@index([userId, timeOfDay])
  @@index([wasCorrect])
}

// Step 2: User Preferences Storage
model UserPreferences {
  id     String @id @default(cuid())
  userId String @unique

  // Study preferences
  dailyGoal        Int      @default(40) // Questions per day
  preferredSystems String[] @default([]) // e.g., ['CV', 'PULM']
  sessionLength    Int      @default(20) // Questions per session
  difficulty       String   @default("adaptive") // 'easy' | 'medium' | 'hard' | 'adaptive'

  // Timing preferences
  wakeTime       String? // HH:MM format, e.g., "07:00"
  studyReminders Boolean @default(true)
  reminderTime   String? // HH:MM format
  reminderDays   Int[]   @default([1, 2, 3, 4, 5]) // 0=Sunday, 1=Monday, etc.

  // UI preferences
  theme             String  @default("light") // 'light' | 'dark' | 'auto'
  soundEnabled      Boolean @default(true)
  hapticFeedback    Boolean @default(true)
  animationsEnabled Boolean @default(true)
  fontSize          String  @default("medium") // 'small' | 'medium' | 'large'

  // Learning preferences
  showHints           Boolean @default(true)
  autoAdvance         Boolean @default(false) // Auto-advance after answering
  explanationDepth    String  @default("standard") // 'brief' | 'standard' | 'detailed'
  showPearls          Boolean @default(true)
  showRelatedConcepts Boolean @default(true)

  // Review preferences
  fsrsEnabled      Boolean @default(true)
  reviewBeforeExam Boolean @default(true)
  mixNewAndReview  Boolean @default(true)

  // Advanced settings
  keyboardShortcuts Boolean @default(true)
  developerMode     Boolean @default(false)
  betaFeatures      Boolean @default(false)

  // Notification preferences
  emailDigest       Boolean @default(true)
  emailFrequency    String  @default("weekly") // 'daily' | 'weekly' | 'never'
  pushNotifications Boolean @default(false)

  // Privacy preferences
  shareAnonymousData Boolean @default(true)
  showOnLeaderboard  Boolean @default(true)

  // Custom JSON for future extensibility
  customSettings Json?

  // Relations
  User User @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  createdAt DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt DateTime @updatedAt

  @@index([userId])
}

// Step 5: User Goal Tracking
model UserGoal {
  id     String @id @default(cuid())
  userId String

  // Goal identification
  title       String // e.g., "Complete 40 questions daily"
  description String? // Optional detailed description
  goalType    String // 'daily' | 'weekly' | 'exam_date' | 'mastery'

  // Goal targets
  targetValue     Int? // Numeric target (e.g., 40 questions)
  targetUnit      String? // 'questions' | 'minutes' | 'conditions' | 'accuracy'
  targetDate      DateTime? // For exam-date goals
  targetSystem    String? // For mastery goals (e.g., "CV")
  targetStability Float? // For FSRS mastery goals (e.g., 0.9)

  // Progress tracking
  currentValue       Int   @default(0)
  progressPercentage Float @default(0) // 0-100

  // Status
  status      String  @default("active") // 'active' | 'completed' | 'paused' | 'failed'
  isRecurring Boolean @default(false) // Daily/weekly goals recur

  // Milestones (JSON array)
  milestones Json? // [{ value: 20, reached: true, date: "2026-01-10" }, ...]

  // Streak tracking (for recurring goals)
  currentStreak Int       @default(0) // Consecutive days/weeks met
  bestStreak    Int       @default(0)
  lastMetDate   DateTime?

  // Motivation
  motivationNotes String? // User's personal motivation
  rewardMessage   String? // Custom message when completed

  // Relations
  User User @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  createdAt   DateTime  @default(now())
  updatedAt   DateTime  @updatedAt
  completedAt DateTime?

  @@index([userId, status])
  @@index([userId, goalType])
  @@index([targetDate])
}

// User Data Improvement Plan - Sprint C

// Step 6: Per-User Confusion Patterns
model UserConfusionPattern {
  id     String @id @default(cuid())
  userId String

  // Confusion pair
  conditionA   String // Real condition
  conditionB   String // Mistaken for
  conditionAId String? // FK to Condition
  conditionBId String? // FK to Condition

  // Tracking
  occurrences    Int      @default(1)
  lastOccurrence DateTime @default(now())

  // Resolution status
  wasResolved      Boolean   @default(false)
  resolvedAt       DateTime?
  resolutionMethod String? // 'practice' | 'study_guide' | 'time'

  // Trigger questions
  questionIds String[] @default([]) // Questions that triggered confusion

  // Pattern severity
  severityScore Float? // 0-1, based on frequency and recency

  // Relations
  User User @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  createdAt DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt DateTime @updatedAt

  @@unique([userId, conditionA, conditionB])
  @@index([userId, wasResolved])
  @@index([userId, severityScore])
  @@index([conditionA])
  @@index([conditionB])
}

// Step 8: Circadian Performance Profile
model UserCircadianProfile {
  id     String @id @default(cuid())
  userId String @unique

  // Hourly performance (0-23)
  hourlyAccuracy Json // { "0": 0.75, "1": 0.80, ... }
  hourlyAttempts Json // { "0": 15, "1": 20, ... }
  hourlyAvgTime  Json? // Average response time by hour

  // Peak performance
  peakHours          Int[]   @default([]) // Hours with best accuracy
  avoidHours         Int[]   @default([]) // Hours with worst accuracy
  optimalStudyWindow String? // e.g., "09:00-11:00, 19:00-21:00"

  // Chronotype classification
  chronotype           String? // 'morning' | 'afternoon' | 'evening' | 'night' | 'variable'
  chronotypeConfidence Float? // 0-1

  // Day of week patterns
  studyDaysOfWeek Int[]  @default([]) // 0=Sunday, 1=Monday, etc.
  weekdayAccuracy Float?
  weekendAccuracy Float?

  // Volume patterns
  avgDailyMinutes   Int?
  avgDailyQuestions Int?
  mostProductiveDay Int? // 0-6

  // Last analysis
  dataPoints   Int      @default(0) // Total attempts analyzed
  lastAnalyzed DateTime @default(now())

  // Relations
  User User @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  createdAt DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt DateTime @updatedAt

  @@index([userId])
  @@index([chronotype])
}

// UNIFIED_ANALYTICS Implementation - Sprint 1

// SessionAnalytics: Aggregated session-level analytics
model SessionAnalytics {
  id        String @id @default(cuid())
  userId    String
  sessionId String @unique

  // Performance curve
  accuracyQ1        Float? // First quarter accuracy
  accuracyQ2        Float?
  accuracyQ3        Float?
  accuracyQ4        Float?
  accuracyTrend     String? // 'improving' | 'stable' | 'declining'
  fatiguePointIndex Int? // Question index where accuracy drops

  // Timing metrics
  avgResponseTime      Int?
  responseTimeVariance Float?
  responseTimeTrend    String? // 'speeding_up' | 'stable' | 'slowing_down'
  totalDurationMinutes Float?

  // Metacognition (from JOL)
  sessionBrierScore  Float? // 0-1, lower is better
  calibrationState   String? // 'overconfident' | 'underconfident' | 'calibrated'
  overconfidenceBias Float? // -1 to 1

  // Flow state
  flowStateMinutes  Float? // Time in optimal challenge zone
  interruptionCount Int     @default(0)
  wasCompleted      Boolean @default(true)

  // System distribution
  systemDistribution     Json? // {"CV": 5, "PULM": 3}
  difficultyDistribution Json? // {"easy": 3, "medium": 5, "hard": 2}

  // Relations
  User         User         @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  StudySession StudySession @relation(fields: [sessionId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  computedAt DateTime @default(now())

  @@index([userId])
  @@index([computedAt])
}

// =============================================================================
// ROLLING 360 STATISTICAL ENGINE
// User-facing "Current Form" metrics based on last 360 Main Session questions
// =============================================================================

/// NCCPA PANCE Blueprint configuration for exam distribution validation
model NCCPABlueprintConfig {
  id             String    @id @default(cuid())
  version        String    @unique // "2024", "2025", etc.
  isActive       Boolean   @default(false)
  weights        Json // {"Cardiovascular": 0.11, "Pulmonary": 0.09, ...}
  systemCount    Int
  effectiveDate  DateTime  @db.Date
  expirationDate DateTime? @db.Date
  createdAt      DateTime  @default(now())

  @@index([isActive])
}

/// Cache table for O(1) dashboard reads of Rolling 360 metrics
model UserRolling360Stats {
  id     String @id @default(cuid())
  userId String @unique

  // Rolling Aggregates (max 360)
  totalInWindow   Int      @default(0)
  correctInWindow Int      @default(0)
  accuracyPercent Decimal? @db.Decimal(5, 2)

  // System Breakdown (JSONB)
  // Format: {"Cardiovascular": {"total": 42, "correct": 35}, ...}
  systemStats Json @default("{}")

  // PANCE Score Prediction (200-800 scale)
  predictedScore  Int?
  scoreConfidence String? // 'collecting' | 'provisional' | 'confident'
  passLikelihood  Decimal? @db.Decimal(5, 2) // 0-100%

  // Blueprint Adherence
  blueprintAdherence      Decimal? @db.Decimal(5, 4) // 0-1 (cosine similarity)
  isValidExamDistribution Boolean  @default(false)

  // Weakness Detection
  weakestSystems   String[] @default([])
  strongestSystems String[] @default([])

  // Window Tracking
  windowStartAttemptId String? // Oldest attempt in window
  windowEndAttemptId   String? // Newest attempt in window
  windowStartTime      DateTime?
  windowEndTime        DateTime?

  // Circular Buffer Index
  currentSlotIndex Int @default(0) // 0-359

  // Metadata
  lastRecalculatedAt   DateTime @default(now())
  recalculationVersion Int      @default(1)
  createdAt            DateTime @default(now())

  User User @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@index([userId])
  @@index([predictedScore])
}

/// Circular buffer table for O(1) sliding window updates (360 slots per user)
model Rolling360Buffer {
  id        String @id @default(cuid())
  userId    String
  slotIndex Int // 0-359

  // Cached data from original QuestionAttempt
  attemptId        String? // FK to QuestionAttempt
  isCorrect        Boolean?
  systemNormalized String?
  answeredAt       DateTime?

  createdAt DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt DateTime @updatedAt

  @@unique([userId, slotIndex])
  @@index([userId, slotIndex])
}

// PersonalizedFSRSParams: Per-user FSRS optimization
model PersonalizedFSRSParams {
  id     String @id @default(cuid())
  userId String @unique

  // Optimized w[] array (21 parameters for FSRS v6)
  // Changed from Json to Float[] for direct Rust optimizer compatibility
  w Float[] // The 21 FSRS weights (v6) - Postgres array for performance

  // Optimization metadata
  sampleSize             Int? // Reviews used for optimization
  lastOptimizedAt        DateTime?
  improvementOverDefault Float? // % Brier score reduction
  optimizationIterations Int?

  // Per-system adjustments
  systemModifiers Json? // {"CV": {"stabilityMult": 1.1, "diffOffset": 0.2}}

  // Validation
  validationBrierScore Float? // Score on holdout set
  parameterBounds      Json? // Constraints used

  // Relations
  User User @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  createdAt DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt DateTime @updatedAt

  @@index([userId])
}

// =============================================================================
// ContentIndex: Global Search Index (OPTIONAL - For Hybrid Content Engine)
// Enables unified search across all content types without multiple JOINs
// Populate via background job or triggers for 2,195+ content items
// =============================================================================
model ContentIndex {
  id         String  @id @default(cuid())
  entityId   String // ID of Drug, Condition, Anatomy, etc.
  entityType String // "Drug", "Condition", "Anatomy", "Symptom", "ECGPattern"
  title      String // Searchable title/name
  body       String  @db.Text // Full-text searchable content
  panceYield Int? // PANCE priority score
  system     String? // Organ system (CV, PULM, etc.)

  // Search optimization
  searchVector String? @db.Text // Optional: For PostgreSQL full-text search

  // Metadata
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt DateTime @updatedAt

  @@index([entityType, entityId])
  @@index([title])
  @@index([entityType, panceYield])
  @@index([system])
}
````

## File: functions/api/questions/condition-drill.ts
````typescript
/**
 * POST /api/questions/condition-drill
 *
 * Generate filtered questions for Condition Drill mode
 * Supports filtering by system and/or subcategory
 */

import { z } from 'zod';
import { authenticatedEndpoint, withCors } from '../_shared/middleware';
import { createEdgePrismaClient, safePrismaDisconnect } from '../_shared/prisma-edge';
import { createEndpointLogger } from '../_shared/secureLogger';

const ConditionDrillSchema = z.object({
  body: z.object({
    system: z.string().optional(),
    subcategory: z.string().optional(),
    difficulty: z.enum(['easy', 'medium', 'hard']).optional(),
    count: z.number().int().min(1).max(20).default(1),
  }),
});

export const onRequestOptions = withCors();

export const onRequestPost = authenticatedEndpoint(ConditionDrillSchema, async (context) => {
  const { env, auth, validated } = context;
  const logger = createEndpointLogger('/api/questions/condition-drill');
  const prisma = createEdgePrismaClient(env.DATABASE_URL);

  try {
    const { system, subcategory, difficulty, count } = validated.body;

    // Build where clause for question query
    const where: any = {
      // Exclude questions without proper structure
      question: { not: null },
      options: { not: null },
      rationale: { not: null },
    };

    // Apply filters if provided
    if (system) {
      where.system = system;
    }

    if (subcategory) {
      where.subcategory = subcategory;
    }

    if (difficulty) {
      where.difficulty = difficulty;
    }

    // Get total count for random selection
    const totalCount = await prisma.question.count({ where });

    if (totalCount === 0) {
      logger.info('No questions found for filters', {
        system,
        subcategory,
        difficulty,
        userId: auth.userId,
      });

      return {
        data: {
          success: false,
          error: 'No questions found for the specified filters',
          filters: { system, subcategory, difficulty },
        },
        status: 404,
      };
    }

    // Fetch multiple random questions
    const questions = [];
    const requestedCount = Math.min(count, totalCount);

    for (let i = 0; i < requestedCount; i++) {
      const randomSkip = Math.floor(Math.random() * totalCount);

      const question = await prisma.question.findFirst({
        where,
        skip: randomSkip,
        select: {
          id: true,
          question: true,
          options: true,
          correctAnswerIndex: true,
          rationale: true,
          pearls: true,
          condition: true,
          conditionId: true,
          system: true,
          subcategory: true,
          topic: true,
          difficulty: true,
          panceYield: true,
          imageUrl: true,
        },
      });

      if (question) {
        questions.push(question);
      }
    }

    if (questions.length === 0) {
      logger.error('Failed to retrieve questions', { userId: auth.userId });
      throw new Error('Failed to retrieve questions');
    }

    logger.info('Condition drill questions retrieved', {
      userId: auth.userId,
      count: questions.length,
      system,
      subcategory,
      difficulty,
    });

    return {
      data: {
        success: true,
        questions,
        totalAvailable: totalCount,
      },
    };
  } catch (error) {
    logger.error('Error generating condition drill questions', {
      error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error),
      userId: auth.userId,
    });
    throw new Error('Failed to generate condition drill questions');
  } finally {
    await safePrismaDisconnect(prisma);
  }
});
````

## File: functions/api/stats/retention.ts
````typescript
/**
 * Retention Stats API Endpoint
 * GET /api/stats/retention
 * Returns retention analytics for dashboard visualizations
 */

import { z } from 'zod';
import { authenticatedEndpoint, withCors } from '../_shared/middleware';
import { createEdgePrismaClient, safePrismaDisconnect } from '../_shared/prisma-edge';
import { createEndpointLogger } from '../_shared/secureLogger';

/** Type for SRS item from Prisma query */
interface SRSItemRecord {
  id: string;
  interval: number;
  dueDate: Date;
  lastReviewed: Date | null;
  easiness: number;
  repetition: number;
  fsrsStability: number | null;
}

const RetentionStatsSchema = z.object({});

export const onRequestOptions = withCors();

export const onRequestGet = authenticatedEndpoint(RetentionStatsSchema, async (context) => {
  const { env, auth } = context;
  const logger = createEndpointLogger('/api/stats/retention');
  const prisma = createEdgePrismaClient(env.DATABASE_URL);

  try {
    const user = await prisma.user.findUnique({
      where: { clerkId: auth.userId },
      select: { id: true },
    });

    if (!user) {
      return {
        data: { error: 'User not found', message: 'Your user account has not been synced yet.' },
        status: 404,
      };
    }

    const userId = user.id;
    const now = new Date();

    const srsItems = await prisma.sRSItem.findMany({
      where: { userId },
      select: {
        id: true,
        interval: true,
        dueDate: true,
        lastReviewed: true,
        easiness: true,
        repetition: true,
        fsrsStability: true,
      },
    });

    const dueCount = srsItems.filter((item: SRSItemRecord) => item.dueDate <= now).length;

    const avgStability =
      srsItems.reduce((sum: number, item: SRSItemRecord) => sum + (item.fsrsStability || 5), 0) /
      (srsItems.length || 1);

    const decayCurveData = Array.from({ length: 31 }, (_, day) => ({
      day,
      retentionProb: Math.max(0, Math.min(100, Math.exp(-day / avgStability) * 100)),
    }));

    const stabilityBuckets = [
      { bucket: '<1d', count: 0, color: 'var(--color-data-fail)' },
      { bucket: '1-3d', count: 0, color: 'var(--color-data-provisional)' },
      { bucket: '3-7d', count: 0, color: 'var(--color-accent)' },
      { bucket: '7-21d', count: 0, color: 'var(--color-accent)' },
      { bucket: '21d+', count: 0, color: 'var(--color-data-pass)' },
    ];

    srsItems.forEach((item: SRSItemRecord) => {
      const interval = item.interval;
      const bucket0 = stabilityBuckets[0];
      const bucket1 = stabilityBuckets[1];
      const bucket2 = stabilityBuckets[2];
      const bucket3 = stabilityBuckets[3];
      const bucket4 = stabilityBuckets[4];
      if (interval < 1 && bucket0) bucket0.count++;
      else if (interval < 3 && bucket1) bucket1.count++;
      else if (interval < 7 && bucket2) bucket2.count++;
      else if (interval < 21 && bucket3) bucket3.count++;
      else if (bucket4) bucket4.count++;
    });

    const lastTuned = new Date(now.getTime() - 6 * 60 * 60 * 1000);
    const tuningReason = 'Pharmacology';
    const adjustment: 'tighten' | 'loosen' = 'tighten';

    logger.info('Fetched retention stats', {
      userId: auth.userId,
      dueCount,
      totalCards: srsItems.length,
    });

    return {
      data: {
        success: true,
        data: {
          dueCount,
          totalCards: srsItems.length,
          decayCurveData,
          stabilityBuckets,
          lastTuned: lastTuned.toISOString(),
          tuningReason,
          adjustment,
        },
      },
    };
  } catch (error) {
    logger.error('Retention stats error', {
      error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error),
      userId: auth.userId,
    });
    throw new Error('Failed to fetch retention stats');
  } finally {
    await safePrismaDisconnect(prisma);
  }
});
````

````typescript
/**
 * API Endpoint: /api/user/stats
 *
 * Get comprehensive user statistics for analytics and FSRS tuning.
 * Returns per-system accuracy, trends, weak areas, and study recommendations.
 *
 * PHASE 1 FIX: Uses blueprint normalization to aggregate both abbreviations
 * and full system names (e.g., "CV" and "Cardiovascular" both count).
 */

import { z } from 'zod';
import { authenticatedEndpoint, withCors } from '../_shared/middleware';
import { createEdgePrismaClient, safePrismaDisconnect } from '../_shared/prisma-edge';
import { createEndpointLogger } from '../_shared/secureLogger';
import {
  getFromCache,
  setInCache,
  getUserStatsCacheKey,
  CACHE_CONFIG,
  isKVAvailable,
} from '../_shared/cache';
import { normalizeSystemName, getAllSystems } from '@/lib/constants/blueprint';

const UserStatsSchema = z.object({
  query: z.object({}).optional(), // No query params for this endpoint
});

export const onRequestOptions = withCors();

export const onRequestGet = authenticatedEndpoint(UserStatsSchema, async (context) => {
  const { env, auth } = context;
  const logger = createEndpointLogger('/api/user/stats');
  let prisma: ReturnType<typeof createEdgePrismaClient> | null = null;

  try {
    const userId = auth.userId;

    // Check cache first if KV is available
    if (isKVAvailable(env.CACHE)) {
      const cacheKey = getUserStatsCacheKey(userId);
      const cached = await getFromCache(env.CACHE, cacheKey);

      if (cached) {
        logger.info('Cache hit for user stats', { userId });
        return {
          data: cached,
          headers: { 'X-Cache': 'HIT' },
        };
      }
    }

    prisma = createEdgePrismaClient(env.DATABASE_URL);

    // Get all attempts for this user
    const allAttempts = await prisma.questionAttempt.findMany({
      where: { userId },
      select: {
        wasCorrect: true,
        system: true,
        conditionId: true,
        mode: true,
        timeSpentMs: true,
        answerChangedCount: true,
        createdAt: true,
      },
      orderBy: { createdAt: 'desc' },
    });

    // Calculate overall stats
    const totalAttempts = allAttempts.length;
    const correctAttempts = allAttempts.filter((a: (typeof allAttempts)[0]) => a.wasCorrect).length;
    const overallAccuracy =
      totalAttempts > 0 ? Math.round((correctAttempts / totalAttempts) * 100) : 0;

    // Calculate average time metrics
    const attemptsWithTime = allAttempts.filter(
      (a: (typeof allAttempts)[0]) => a.timeSpentMs && a.timeSpentMs > 0
    );
    const avgTimeMs =
      attemptsWithTime.length > 0
        ? Math.round(
            attemptsWithTime.reduce(
              (sum: number, a: (typeof attemptsWithTime)[0]) => sum + (a.timeSpentMs || 0),
              0
            ) / attemptsWithTime.length
          )
        : null;
    const avgAnswerChanges =
      attemptsWithTime.length > 0
        ? +(
            attemptsWithTime.reduce(
              (sum: number, a: (typeof attemptsWithTime)[0]) => sum + (a.answerChangedCount || 0),
              0
            ) / attemptsWithTime.length
          ).toFixed(2)
        : null;

    // PHASE 1 FIX: Normalize all system names and aggregate by canonical name
    // This handles both "CV" and "Cardiovascular" being counted together
    const systemMap = new Map<string, Array<(typeof allAttempts)[0]>>();

    for (const attempt of allAttempts) {
      if (attempt.system) {
        const normalizedSystem = normalizeSystemName(attempt.system);
        if (!systemMap.has(normalizedSystem)) {
          systemMap.set(normalizedSystem, []);
        }
        systemMap.get(normalizedSystem)!.push(attempt);
      }
    }

    // Calculate per-system stats using normalized names
    const systemStats: Record<
      string,
      {
        total: number;
        correct: number;
        accuracy: number;
        trend: 'improving' | 'declining' | 'neutral';
        avgTimeMs: number | null;
        lastAttempt: string | null;
      }
    > = {};

    // Get canonical system list from blueprint
    const canonicalSystems = getAllSystems();

    for (const system of canonicalSystems) {
      const systemAttempts = systemMap.get(system) || [];
      const total = systemAttempts.length;
      const correct = systemAttempts.filter((a: (typeof systemAttempts)[0]) => a.wasCorrect).length;
      const accuracy = total > 0 ? Math.round((correct / total) * 100) : 0;

      // Calculate trend
      let trend: 'improving' | 'declining' | 'neutral' = 'neutral';
      if (systemAttempts.length >= 10) {
        const recent5 = systemAttempts.slice(0, 5);
        const previous5 = systemAttempts.slice(5, 10);
        const recentAcc = recent5.filter((a: (typeof recent5)[0]) => a.wasCorrect).length / 5;
        const prevAcc = previous5.filter((a: (typeof previous5)[0]) => a.wasCorrect).length / 5;

        if (recentAcc > prevAcc + 0.15) trend = 'improving';
        else if (recentAcc < prevAcc - 0.15) trend = 'declining';
      }

      // Calculate average time for this system
      const systemWithTime = systemAttempts.filter(
        (a: (typeof systemAttempts)[0]) => a.timeSpentMs && a.timeSpentMs > 0
      );
      const sysAvgTime =
        systemWithTime.length > 0
          ? Math.round(
              systemWithTime.reduce(
                (sum: number, a: (typeof systemWithTime)[0]) => sum + (a.timeSpentMs || 0),
                0
              ) / systemWithTime.length
            )
          : null;

      systemStats[system] = {
        total,
        correct,
        accuracy,
        trend,
        avgTimeMs: sysAvgTime,
        lastAttempt: systemAttempts[0]?.createdAt?.toISOString() || null,
      };
    }

    // Identify weak areas (systems with accuracy < 70% and at least 5 attempts)
    const weakAreas = Object.entries(systemStats)
      .filter(
        ([_sys, stats]: [string, (typeof systemStats)[string]]) =>
          stats.total >= 5 && stats.accuracy < 70
      )
      .sort(
        (a: [string, (typeof systemStats)[string]], b: [string, (typeof systemStats)[string]]) =>
          a[1].accuracy - b[1].accuracy
      )
      .map(([system, stats]: [string, (typeof systemStats)[string]]) => ({
        system,
        accuracy: stats.accuracy,
        attempts: stats.total,
        trend: stats.trend,
      }));

    // Identify strong areas (systems with accuracy >= 80% and at least 10 attempts)
    const strongAreas = Object.entries(systemStats)
      .filter(
        ([_sys, stats]: [string, (typeof systemStats)[string]]) =>
          stats.total >= 10 && stats.accuracy >= 80
      )
      .sort(
        (a: [string, (typeof systemStats)[string]], b: [string, (typeof systemStats)[string]]) =>
          b[1].accuracy - a[1].accuracy
      )
      .map(([system, stats]: [string, (typeof systemStats)[string]]) => ({
        system,
        accuracy: stats.accuracy,
        attempts: stats.total,
      }));

    // Calculate per-condition stats (top 20 most attempted)
    const conditionCounts: Record<string, { total: number; correct: number; conditionId: string }> =
      {};
    for (const attempt of allAttempts as typeof allAttempts) {
      if (attempt.conditionId) {
        if (!conditionCounts[attempt.conditionId]) {
          conditionCounts[attempt.conditionId] = {
            total: 0,
            correct: 0,
            conditionId: attempt.conditionId,
          };
        }
        conditionCounts[attempt.conditionId].total++;
        if (attempt.wasCorrect) conditionCounts[attempt.conditionId].correct++;
      }
    }

    const conditionStats = Object.values(conditionCounts)
      .filter((c: (typeof conditionCounts)[string]) => c.total >= 3) // At least 3 attempts
      .map((c: (typeof conditionCounts)[string]) => ({
        conditionId: c.conditionId,
        total: c.total,
        correct: c.correct,
        accuracy: Math.round((c.correct / c.total) * 100),
      }))
      .sort((a, b) => b.total - a.total)
      .slice(0, 30); // Top 30 conditions

    // Identify weak conditions (accuracy < 60% with at least 5 attempts)
    const weakConditions = Object.values(conditionCounts)
      .filter((c: (typeof conditionCounts)[string]) => c.total >= 5 && c.correct / c.total < 0.6)
      .map((c: (typeof conditionCounts)[string]) => ({
        conditionId: c.conditionId,
        total: c.total,
        correct: c.correct,
        accuracy: Math.round((c.correct / c.total) * 100),
      }))
      .sort((a, b) => a.accuracy - b.accuracy)
      .slice(0, 10); // Top 10 weakest

    // Calculate study streak (days with at least 1 attempt)
    const attemptDates = new Set(
      allAttempts.map((a: (typeof allAttempts)[0]) => a.createdAt.toISOString().split('T')[0])
    );
    const sortedDates = Array.from(attemptDates).sort().reverse() as string[];

    let currentStreak = 0;
    const today = new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0];
    const yesterday = new Date(Date.now() - 86400000).toISOString().split('T')[0];

    // Check if studied today or yesterday
    const mostRecentDate = sortedDates[0];
    if (mostRecentDate && (mostRecentDate === today || mostRecentDate === yesterday)) {
      currentStreak = 1;
      for (let i = 1; i < sortedDates.length; i++) {
        const prevIdx = i - 1;
        const prevDateStr = sortedDates[prevIdx];
        const currDateStr = sortedDates[i];
        if (!prevDateStr || !currDateStr) break;
        const prevDate = new Date(prevDateStr);
        const currDate = new Date(currDateStr);
        const diffDays = Math.floor((prevDate.getTime() - currDate.getTime()) / 86400000);

        if (diffDays === 1) {
          currentStreak++;
        } else {
          break;
        }
      }
    }

    // Get questions seen count
    const questionsSeenCount = await prisma.userQuestionSeen.count({
      where: { userId },
    });

    // Calculate time-based analytics (last 7 days vs previous 7 days)
    const now = new Date();
    const sevenDaysAgo = new Date(now.getTime() - 7 * 86400000);
    const fourteenDaysAgo = new Date(now.getTime() - 14 * 86400000);

    const last7DaysAttempts = allAttempts.filter(
      (a: (typeof allAttempts)[0]) => a.createdAt >= sevenDaysAgo
    );
    const prev7DaysAttempts = allAttempts.filter(
      (a: (typeof allAttempts)[0]) => a.createdAt >= fourteenDaysAgo && a.createdAt < sevenDaysAgo
    );

    const last7Accuracy =
      last7DaysAttempts.length > 0
        ? Math.round(
            (last7DaysAttempts.filter((a: (typeof last7DaysAttempts)[0]) => a.wasCorrect).length /
              last7DaysAttempts.length) *
              100
          )
        : null;
    const prev7Accuracy =
      prev7DaysAttempts.length > 0
        ? Math.round(
            (prev7DaysAttempts.filter((a: (typeof prev7DaysAttempts)[0]) => a.wasCorrect).length /
              prev7DaysAttempts.length) *
              100
          )
        : null;

    // Generate study recommendations
    const recommendations: string[] = [];

    if (weakAreas.length > 0) {
      recommendations.push(
        `Focus on ${weakAreas[0].system} - currently at ${weakAreas[0].accuracy}% accuracy`
      );
    }

    if (currentStreak === 0) {
      recommendations.push('Start a study streak today!');
    } else if (currentStreak >= 7) {
      recommendations.push(`Great ${currentStreak}-day streak! Keep it up!`);
    }

    const underStudiedSystems = Object.entries(systemStats)
      .filter(([_sys, stats]: [string, (typeof systemStats)[string]]) => stats && stats.total < 10)
      .map(([system, _stats]: [string, (typeof systemStats)[string]]) => system);

    if (underStudiedSystems.length > 0) {
      recommendations.push(`Try more questions in: ${underStudiedSystems.slice(0, 3).join(', ')}`);
    }

    const responseData = {
      success: true,
      stats: {
        overall: {
          totalAttempts,
          correctAttempts,
          accuracy: overallAccuracy,
          questionsSeenCount,
          currentStreak,
          totalStudyDays: attemptDates.size,
          avgTimeMs,
          avgAnswerChanges,
        },
        bySystems: systemStats,
        byConditions: conditionStats,
        weakAreas,
        strongAreas,
        weakConditions,
        recentPerformance: {
          last7Days: {
            attempts: last7DaysAttempts.length,
            accuracy: last7Accuracy,
          },
          previous7Days: {
            attempts: prev7DaysAttempts.length,
            accuracy: prev7Accuracy,
          },
          trend:
            last7Accuracy !== null && prev7Accuracy !== null
              ? last7Accuracy > prev7Accuracy
                ? 'improving'
                : last7Accuracy < prev7Accuracy
                  ? 'declining'
                  : 'stable'
              : 'insufficient_data',
        },
        recommendations,
      },
    };

    // Cache the result if KV is available
    if (isKVAvailable(env.CACHE)) {
      const cacheKey = getUserStatsCacheKey(userId);
      await setInCache(env.CACHE, cacheKey, responseData, CACHE_CONFIG.TTL.USER_STATS);
    }

    logger.info('Fetched user stats', {
      userId,
      totalAttempts,
      accuracy: overallAccuracy,
      weakAreasCount: weakAreas.length,
      systemsCounted: Object.keys(systemStats).filter((k) => systemStats[k].total > 0).length,
    });

    return {
      data: responseData,
      headers: { 'X-Cache': 'MISS' },
    };
  } catch (error) {
    logger.error('Error fetching user stats', {
      error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error),
      userId: auth.userId,
    });
    throw new Error('Failed to fetch user stats');
  } finally {
    await safePrismaDisconnect(prisma);
  }
````

````typescript
import path from 'path';
import { defineConfig, loadEnv, Plugin } from 'vite';
import react from '@vitejs/plugin-react';
import { VitePWA } from 'vite-plugin-pwa';
import { sentryVitePlugin } from '@sentry/vite-plugin';

/**
 * Vite plugin to completely remove Prisma imports from browser bundles.
 * Uses transform to strip out Prisma imports before they reach Rollup.
 */
function prismaExcludePlugin(): Plugin {
  const prismaPatterns = [
    '@prisma/client',
    '@prisma/client/edge',
    '.prisma/client',
    '@prisma/extension-accelerate',
  ];

  return {
    name: 'prisma-exclude',
    enforce: 'pre',
    resolveId(source, importer) {
      // Don't intercept imports from server-side code (functions/)
      if (importer && importer.includes('/functions/')) {
        return null;
      }
      
      // Intercept @prisma/client and related packages
      if (prismaPatterns.some((p) => source === p || source.includes(p))) {
        return { id: 'virtual:prisma-stub', moduleSideEffects: false };
      }
      // Intercept lib/prisma imports (various forms)
      if (
        source.endsWith('lib/prisma') ||
        source.endsWith('lib/prisma.ts') ||
        source === '../prisma' ||
        source === '../../lib/prisma' ||
        source === '@/lib/prisma'
      ) {
        return { id: 'virtual:prisma-stub', moduleSideEffects: false };
      }
      return null;
    },
    load(id) {
      if (id === 'virtual:prisma-stub') {
        // Return a stub module that exports empty objects/functions
        return `
          export const PrismaClient = class PrismaClient {
            constructor() {
              if (typeof window !== 'undefined') {
                console.warn('[Browser] PrismaClient is not available in browser bundles');
              }
            }
          };
          export const Prisma = {};
          export const prisma = null;
          export default { PrismaClient, Prisma };
        `;
      }
      return null;
    },
    // Transform hook to catch imports that slip through resolveId
    transform(code, id) {
      // Skip node_modules and functions/ (server-side code)
      if (id.includes('node_modules') || id.includes('/functions/')) return null;

      // Check if the file contains Prisma imports
      const hasPrismaImport = prismaPatterns.some(
        (p) => code.includes(`from '${p}'`) || code.includes(`from "${p}"`) || code.includes(`import('${p}')`) || code.includes(`import("${p}")`)
      );

      if (hasPrismaImport) {
        // Replace import statements with stub imports
        let transformed = code;
        let importCounter = 0;

        for (const pattern of prismaPatterns) {
          const escapedPattern = pattern.replace('/', '\\/').replace('.', '\\.');
          
          // Replace static imports with unique variable names
          transformed = transformed.replace(
            new RegExp(`import\\s*{[^}]*}\\s*from\\s*['"]${escapedPattern}['"]`, 'g'),
            () => {
              importCounter++;
              return `/* [Prisma removed ${importCounter}] */ const { PrismaClient: _PC${importCounter}, Prisma: _P${importCounter} } = { PrismaClient: class {}, Prisma: {} }`;
            }
          );
          // Replace default imports
          transformed = transformed.replace(
            new RegExp(`import\\s+\\w+\\s+from\\s*['"]${escapedPattern}['"]`, 'g'),
            () => {
              importCounter++;
              return `/* [Prisma removed ${importCounter}] */ const _prismaDefault${importCounter} = { PrismaClient: class {}, Prisma: {} }`;
            }
          );
          // Replace dynamic imports with a null promise
          transformed = transformed.replace(
            new RegExp(`import\\(['"]${escapedPattern}['"]\\)`, 'g'),
            `Promise.resolve({ PrismaClient: class {}, Prisma: {}, prisma: null })`
          );
        }
        return { code: transformed, map: null };
      }

      return null;
    },
  };
}

              authToken: env.SENTRY_AUTH_TOKEN,
              sourcemaps: {
                assets: './dist/**',
                ignore: ['node_modules'],
                filesToDeleteAfterUpload: ['./dist/**/*.map'],
              },
              telemetry: false,
            }),
          ]
        : []),
    ],
    define: {
      // Make VITE_USE_MOCK available to client code
      'import.meta.env.VITE_USE_MOCK': JSON.stringify(env.VITE_USE_MOCK || 'false'),
      // Global shim for CJS modules
      global: 'window',
      // Process shims for browser compatibility
      // Note: Using 'typeof process' pattern to avoid breaking code that checks for process existence
      'process.env.NODE_ENV': JSON.stringify(mode),
      'process.env.VITEST': 'undefined',
      'process.env.VITEST_WORKER_ID': 'undefined',
      'process.env.API_BASE_URL': 'undefined',
      'process.env.DATABASE_URL': 'undefined',
      'process.env.GEMINI_API_KEY': 'undefined',
      // Fallback for any other process.env access
      'process.env': '{}',
      // Define process object for typeof checks
      'process.browser': 'true',
      'process.version': '""',
    },
    resolve: {
      dedupe: ['lucide-react', 'react', 'react-dom'],
      alias: {
        // Preserve legacy absolute imports that assume repo root
        '@': path.resolve(__dirname, '.'),
        // Preferred alias for source files
        '@src': path.resolve(__dirname, './src'),
        // Force ESM build of lucide-react
        'lucide-react': 'lucide-react/dist/esm/lucide-react.js',
      },
    },
    build: {
      rollupOptions: {
        // NOTE: Prisma packages are now handled by prismaExcludePlugin
        // which stubs them out instead of externalizing (which leaves bare imports)
        // sharp is a Node.js-only image processing library - must never be bundled for browser
        external: ['sharp'],
        onwarn(warning, warn) {
          if (
            warning.code === 'SOURCEMAP_ERROR' &&
            warning.loc?.file &&
            (warning.loc.file.includes('components/navigation/CommandCenterHub.tsx') ||
              warning.loc.file.includes('components/dashboard/TrainingMenu.tsx'))
          ) {
            return;
          }
          warn(warning);
        },
        output: {
          // Add interop compatibility mode to handle CJS/ESM mixing gracefully
          interop: 'compat',
          // Safety net polyfill for CommonJS remnants and Node.js globals
          intro: `
var global = global || window;
var exports = exports || {};
if (typeof process === 'undefined') {
  var process = { env: { NODE_ENV: '${mode}' }, browser: true, version: '', cwd: function() { return '/'; } };
}
`,
        },
        // Ensure lucide-react is treated as side-effect-free for optimal tree-shaking
        treeshake: {
          moduleSideEffects: (id) => {
            if (id && id.includes('lucide-react')) return false;
            // Explicitly return true for all other modules to satisfy Rollup boolean return
            return true;
          },
        },
      },
      chunkSizeWarningLimit: 700, // Increased limit for larger vendor chunks
      // Conditionally enable source maps based on environment
      // In production, use 'hidden' to generate maps but not reference them in the bundle
      sourcemap: mode === 'production' ? 'hidden' : true,
      // Improve build performance
      minify: 'esbuild',
      target: 'esnext',
    },
    worker: {
      format: 'es', // Use ES modules format for workers (required for WASM)
      rollupOptions: {
        output: {
          format: 'es',
        },
      },
    },
    optimizeDeps: {
      include: ['react', 'react-dom', '@clerk/clerk-react', 'framer-motion'],
      // Avoid prebundling the entire lucide icon set; rely on per-icon ESM imports for tree-shaking
      exclude: ['lucide-react'],
    },
  };
});
````
